title.en: AI: from models to actual work

lead.zh: 翻译、总结、写代码，都可以写成一个输入与输出。
lead.en: Translation, summarization and code generation can all be expressed as an input and an output.

key.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）处理和生成语言；应用把这种能力接到具体任务里。
key.en: A large language model processes and generates language; an application connects it to a task.

lines.zh: 输入：将价格从小到大排

caption.zh: 本课的例子从这些输入与输出展开。
caption.en: We will follow concrete inputs and outputs throughout the class.

beats.zh: 大语言模型，简称LLM，处理和生成语言。这里输入中文，按翻译要求生成英文。
beats.en: A large language model, or LLM, processes and generates language. A translation request takes Chinese and returns English.

beats.zh: 换成会议记录，模型把句子整理成事项、负责人和日期。输入材料与要求一起决定输出内容。
beats.en: With meeting notes, it organizes sentences into tasks, owners and dates. The material and instructions both shape the output.

beats.zh: 代码是给计算机执行的指令。模型先生成程序，运行后才得到排序数字。
beats.en: Code gives a computer instructions. A model generates the program; running it produces the sorted numbers.

zh: 大语言模型，简称LLM，处理和生成语言。这里输入中文，按翻译要求生成英文。
换成会议记录，模型把句子整理成事项、负责人和日期。输入材料与要求一起决定输出内容。
代码是给计算机执行的指令。模型先生成程序，运行后才得到排序数字。
刚才看到了输出；把背后的应用、模型和计算机分开，才知道每一步是谁完成的。
en: A large language model, or LLM, processes and generates language. A translation request takes Chinese and returns English.
With meeting notes, it organizes sentences into tasks, owners and dates. The material and instructions both shape the output.
Code gives a computer instructions. A model generates the program; running it produces the sorted numbers.
We have seen outputs. Separate application, model and computer to identify who performs each step.

zh: 直接从左边读起：输入“会议改到周三”，要求翻译，得到右边的英文。再看总结和代码。任务不同，界面里发生的共同动作都是：把一段内容送入模型，再生成一段新内容。LLM 是 large language model，大语言模型。先把这个名字和动作对应起来。
今天的顺序就是拆开这件事：文字怎样进入模型，回答怎样一个个片段长出来，训练时发生了什么。然后把工具接进来，看它怎样从一次回答变成连续工作。后半场再打开计算机这一层，看芯片、集群和引擎。
en: Read the translation example first, then the summary and code examples. Different tasks share a text-in, text-out interface. LLM means large language model. Associate the name with the operation before introducing more terminology.
We will unpack text representation, generation and training, then add tools and ongoing work. After the break we will open the computing layer: chips, clusters and engines.

transition.zh: 刚才看到了输出；把背后的应用、模型和计算机分开，才知道每一步是谁完成的。
transition.en: We have seen outputs. Separate application, model and computer to identify who performs each step.

opening.zh: 先看三种输入输出：翻译换语言，会议整理成表格，编程生成可执行指令。它们共用文字接口，今天就从这个共同动作拆开讲。
opening.en: Compare three text interfaces: translation, a meeting table and a generated program. Start from this shared operation and unpack how it works.

question.zh: 为什么翻译、表格、代码放在一起？
question.en: Why group translation, tables and code?

answer.zh: 这些任务的输入和输出都能用文字表示；用途不同，生成接口可以共用。
answer.en: All can use text inputs and outputs, so different purposes can share a generation interface.

question.zh: 右边的排序数字是模型直接算的吗？
question.en: Did the model directly compute the sorted numbers?

answer.zh: 图里省略了程序正文：模型先生成排序程序，程序运行才得到数字。后面会把两步拆开。
answer.en: The code body is abbreviated here: the model generates a program, and execution produces the numbers. Later we separate those operations.

question.zh: 这一页怎样接到下一步？
question.en: How does this connect to the next step?

answer.zh: 刚才看到了输出；把背后的应用、模型和计算机分开，才知道每一步是谁完成的。
answer.en: We have seen outputs. Separate application, model and computer to identify who performs each step.

demonstration.zh: 按翻译、会议、代码顺序展开三列；最后指一次“生成程序→运行”。
demonstration.en: Reveal translation, meeting and code in order; point once to generate code → run.

pause.zh: 停在翻译输出，让学生用自己的话说输入、任务、输出各是什么。
pause.en: Hold the translation result; let learners identify input, task and output.

title.en: What are an LLM, an agent and an application?

lead.zh: LLM 是 Large Language Model，大语言模型。
lead.en: LLM means Large Language Model: a learned numerical model that computes output from input.

key.zh: 模型生成提议；应用组织输入、执行与结果。
key.en: The model proposes; the application organizes input, execution and results.

caption.zh: 这里画的是组成关系；后面会展开实际的调用往返。
caption.en: These are components; later figures show the request and response paths.

beats.zh: 应用是你操作的软件：收集要求和文件，显示结果，也能调用工具。
beats.en: The app collects requests and files, displays output and can call tools.

beats.zh: 模型是生成部分：根据应用送入的文字，计算接下来写什么，再交回应用。
beats.en: The model computes what to write from supplied text and returns it to the app.

beats.zh: 模型需要在真实机器上运行。图里的芯片执行数字运算；应用、模型和机器共同完成一次回答。
beats.en: A model runs on a physical machine. Chips perform numerical operations; app, model and machine together deliver a response.

zh: LLM 是 Large Language Model，大语言模型。它接收一段输入，用学到的参数计算输出。聊天网站、编程助手和办公助手是应用：应用负责接收文件、组织对话、调用模型和展示结果。Agent 指能够围绕目标，依据当前观察选择动作并继续工作的系统。一个应用可以只有一次模型调用，也可以组织一个或多个 Agent。
把“帮我写文章”交给模型，得到草稿，是一次生成。让程序搜集资料、把结果交给模型、再按缺失内容继续检索，是应用组织的一串动作。两者可以使用同一个模型。
en: LLM means Large Language Model: a learned numerical model that computes output from input. An application handles files, conversation, model calls and presentation. An agent is a system that chooses actions from observations while pursuing a goal. An app may use one model call or organize several agents.

Generating a draft from a request is one call. Searching for sources, returning them to the model and searching again for missing information is a sequence organized by software. Both can use the same model.

zh: 应用是你操作的软件：收集要求和文件，显示结果，也能调用工具。
模型是生成部分：根据应用送入的文字，计算接下来写什么，再交回应用。
模型需要在真实机器上运行。图里的芯片执行数字运算；应用、模型和机器共同完成一次回答。
模型接收的文字怎样变成数值？先从 Token 和编号看输入。
en: The app collects requests and files, displays output and can call tools.
The model computes what to write from supplied text and returns it to the app.
A model runs on a physical machine. Chips perform numerical operations; app, model and machine together deliver a response.
How does text become numerical input? Start with tokens and IDs.

question.zh: 为什么要拆三层？
question.en: Why separate three layers?

answer.zh: 同一个模型可以接到不同应用；同一个应用也能换模型。分开后才能说明能力从哪里来。
answer.en: One model can support different apps, and one app can use different models. Separation identifies where capabilities come from.

question.zh: 是模型先算完，再给机器算一次吗？
question.en: Does the machine compute again after the model finishes?

answer.zh: 不是。图中机器执行的就是模型这份数字运算；这里画组成关系，不画时间先后。
answer.en: No. The machine executes the model's computation; this figure shows components rather than chronological stages.

question.en: How does this connect to the next step?

answer.zh: 模型接收的文字怎样变成数值？先从 Token 和编号看输入。
answer.en: How does text become numerical input? Start with tokens and IDs.

demonstration.en: Reveal app, model and machine; identify the same computation across model and hardware.

title.zh: 文字先变成 Token，再变成编号

lead.zh: Token 是模型处理的片段；片段可以小于一个词。
lead.en: Tokens are pieces processed by a model; a piece can be smaller than a word.

key.zh: Token 的切分由分词器决定。
key.en: The tokenizer determines the pieces.

result.zh: 片段 → 数字编号 → 模型计算

caption.zh: rain / coat、编号和数值为切分示意；实际切法由具体分词器决定。
caption.en: Pieces, IDs and values are illustrative; an actual tokenizer determines the split.

beats.zh: raincoat 是英语里的雨衣。分词器是把文字切成片段的程序；每个片段叫一个 Token。
beats.en: Raincoat is one English word. A tokenizer is a program that divides text into pieces; each piece is a token.

beats.zh: 示例先切出 rain。一个词可以有多个 Token，Token 不固定等于一个单词或汉字。
beats.en: Our example first takes rain. A word can contain several tokens; a token is not always one word or Chinese character.

beats.zh: 再切出 coat。词表给每个片段一个编号；编号像目录号，本身不表示这个词有多大或多重要。
beats.en: Next comes coat. A vocabulary gives each piece an ID, like a catalog number; a larger ID does not mean greater importance.

beats.zh: 模型按编号查出一串数值，再用这些数参与运算。这串数叫数值表示，也常叫向量。
beats.en: The model uses the ID to look up a list of numbers for computation. This numerical representation is also called a vector.

zh: raincoat 是英语里的雨衣。分词器是把文字切成片段的程序；每个片段叫一个 Token。
示例先切出 rain。一个词可以有多个 Token，Token 不固定等于一个单词或汉字。
再切出 coat。词表给每个片段一个编号；编号像目录号，本身不表示这个词有多大或多重要。
模型按编号查出一串数值，再用这些数参与运算。这串数叫数值表示，也常叫向量。
有了数值输入，接着看一个新片段怎样接回前文，让回答继续增长。
en: Raincoat is one English word. A tokenizer is a program that divides text into pieces; each piece is a token.
Our example first takes rain. A word can contain several tokens; a token is not always one word or Chinese character.
Next comes coat. A vocabulary gives each piece an ID, like a catalog number; a larger ID does not mean greater importance.
The model uses the ID to look up a list of numbers for computation. This numerical representation is also called a vector.
With numerical input, see how a new piece feeds back into the prefix to grow a response.

zh: 先只显示 raincoat。让观众看到，我们眼里是一个完整单词。推进一次，出现 rain；再推进一次，出现 coat。两个小块下面是各自的编号。模型处理的是这些编号以及从编号得到的数值表示。
Token 没有固定等于一个词或一个汉字。常见词可能是一个片段，较少见的词可能拆成多个，空格、标点和代码也会被编码。不同模型使用的分词器可能不同，所以相同文字的 Token 数也可能不同。这里用示意切分，是为了先看到单位是什么。
en: Show the word first, then reveal each piece and its ID. Explain that the model processes numerical representations derived from these IDs.

A token has no fixed equivalence to an English word or Chinese character. Punctuation, spaces and code are encoded too. Tokenizers can divide the same text differently; this diagram illustrates the idea rather than a specific measured split.

transition.zh: 有了数值输入，接着看一个新片段怎样接回前文，让回答继续增长。
transition.en: With numerical input, see how a new piece feeds back into the prefix to grow a response.

opening.zh: 文字要变成机器能处理的输入。先别把 Token 想成一个新概念体系，只把它当作一块文字。raincoat 在英语里是一个词，但可以拆成 rain 和 coat。分词器负责切分和查编号，模型再从编号查出数值列表。编号像目录号，数值列表才进入后面的计算。这里的四个数不是四条人工写好的词义，而是训练时学到的表示。
opening.en: Text must become numerical input. Treat a token simply as a piece of text. Raincoat is one English word, but our illustration splits it into rain and coat. A tokenizer divides text and assigns IDs; the model looks up a numerical vector for each ID. An ID is a catalog reference. The vector is a learned representation, not a list of hand-written definitions.

question.zh: 为什么不直接一个词配一个编号？
question.en: Why not assign one ID to every whole word?

answer.zh: 固定词表要处理常见词、少见词、代码和不同语言。允许片段组合，能用有限词表表示更多文字。
answer.en: A finite vocabulary must represent common and rare words, code and many languages. Reusable pieces can compose more text.

question.zh: 编号和这四个数是怎么来的？
question.en: Where do the IDs and four numbers come from?

answer.zh: 分词器词表固定片段与编号的对应；模型的查表参数给出向量，训练时会调整这些数。图中数值是算例。
answer.en: The tokenizer vocabulary defines IDs; the model's embedding parameters supply vectors and are adjusted during training. These values are illustrative.

question.zh: 这一页怎样接到下一步？
question.en: How does this connect to the next step?

answer.zh: 有了数值输入，接着看一个新片段怎样接回前文，让回答继续增长。
answer.en: With numerical input, see how a new piece feeds back into the prefix to grow a response.

demonstration.zh: 逐块展开 rain、coat、编号、数值；用手指沿同一块文字追到底。
demonstration.en: Trace rain and coat separately through pieces, IDs and values.

pause.zh: 停在两块片段，让学生回答：一个单词在这里是几个 Token？
pause.en: Hold the two pieces and ask how many tokens this one word has.

takeaway.zh: Token 的切分由分词器决定。
takeaway.en: The tokenizer determines the pieces.

title.zh: Transformer 是结构，自回归是生成方式
title.en: Transformer is an architecture; autoregression is a generation scheme

lead.zh: Token 是分词器定义的片段，不固定等于一个字。
lead.en: A token is a tokenizer-defined piece, not necessarily one character.

key.zh: Transformer 组织内部计算；自回归把新片段接回已有序列。
key.en: Transformer organizes computation; autoregression feeds new pieces back into the sequence.

detail.zh: 下一轮使用更长的前文

caption.zh: 箭头表示数据如何进入下一轮。
caption.en: Arrows show information feeding the next round.

beats.zh: 已有文字是 The sky is。每一步都以上一步已经有的文字为起点。
beats.en: The text so far is The sky is. Each step starts with the text already available.

beats.zh: 模型根据这段前文计算下一 Token 的概率；图中的模型重复使用，不需要每写一个词就重新训练。
beats.en: The model computes next-token probabilities from the prefix. It is reused, without retraining for each new word.

beats.zh: 这次选中 blue，意思是蓝色。它是新增的一小块，还不是整篇回答。
beats.en: This draw selects blue, one new piece rather than the whole response.

beats.zh: 把 blue 接到前文后，就得到 The sky is blue。再按同样步骤继续；这个用已有输出接着生成的过程叫自回归。
beats.en: Appending blue gives The sky is blue. Repeat the same steps: generating from previous output is called autoregressive generation.

zh: Token 是分词器定义的片段，不固定等于一个字。模型先把片段编号变成数值表示，再经过 Transformer 的注意力和其他计算，得到下一片段的分布。Transformer 描述内部怎样组织计算；自回归描述把已有输出接回前文、继续生成的方式。两者不是同义词。
以“吃好了”为例，假设本例分成“吃／好／了”：先有“吃”，生成“好”；再用“吃好”生成“了”。这里的分词是假设，真正切法由分词器决定。长回答是这个步骤反复进行，不是一次从库中取出整篇文章。
en: A token is a tokenizer-defined piece, not necessarily one character. Its ID selects a numerical representation, and Transformer computations produce a distribution for the next piece. Transformer describes the computation architecture; autoregression describes feeding previous output back into generation. They are different concepts.

Assume the example 吃好了 is split into 吃 / 好 / 了. After 吃, generate 好; then use 吃好 to generate 了. The split is illustrative. A long response repeats a prediction operation rather than retrieving a complete stored article.

zh: 已有文字是 The sky is。每一步都以上一步已经有的文字为起点。
模型根据这段前文计算下一 Token 的概率；图中的模型重复使用，不需要每写一个词就重新训练。
这次选中 blue，意思是蓝色。它是新增的一小块，还不是整篇回答。
把 blue 接到前文后，就得到 The sky is blue。再按同样步骤继续；这个用已有输出接着生成的过程叫自回归。
每轮计算还需要利用前文；注意力说明不同输入怎样共同影响这一步。
en: The text so far is The sky is. Each step starts with the text already available.
The model computes next-token probabilities from the prefix. It is reused, without retraining for each new word.
This draw selects blue, one new piece rather than the whole response.
Appending blue gives The sky is blue. Repeat the same steps: generating from previous output is called autoregressive generation.
Each prediction uses prior context. Attention shows how input positions contribute to this step.

opening.en: A token is a tokenizer-defined piece, not necessarily one character.

question.zh: 只预测下一个片段，怎么会写文章？
question.en: How can one-token prediction write an article?

answer.zh: 把这个操作连续做很多次；每次已写出的内容都加入下一次条件，逐渐形成长输出。
answer.en: Repeat it many times, including generated text in subsequent conditioning.

question.zh: 怎样知道可以停了？
question.en: How does generation stop?

answer.zh: 生成结束标记或达到应用设定的停止条件，循环结束。不是每次都预先知道文章长度。
answer.en: An end token or an application stop condition ends the loop; length need not be fixed in advance.

question.zh: 这一页怎样接到下一步？
question.en: How does this connect to the next step?

answer.zh: 每轮计算还需要利用前文；注意力说明不同输入怎样共同影响这一步。
answer.en: Each prediction uses prior context. Attention shows how input positions contribute to this step.

demonstration.zh: 沿一圈指出已有前文、blue和更长前文；不重复调温度。
demonstration.en: Trace one complete circuit without repeating the temperature experiment.

pause.zh: 停在回箭头：下一轮读取的是三块还是四块？
pause.en: Hold the feedback arrow: does the next round read three pieces or four?

takeaway.zh: Transformer 组织内部计算；自回归把新片段接回已有序列。
takeaway.en: Transformer organizes computation; autoregression feeds new pieces back into the sequence.

instruction.en: Keep the worked example and mechanism.

title.zh: Transformer 是结构，自回归是生成方式
title.en: Transformer is an architecture; autoregression is a generation scheme

title.zh: 注意力：按权重组合信息

lead.zh: 注意力：让当前计算按不同比例使用前文中的信息。
lead.en: Attention lets the current computation use information from earlier positions in different proportions.

key.zh: 注意力机制：在计算时组合上下文中不同位置的信息。
key.en: Attention combines information from different context positions.

caption.zh: 自行车/天气、两维数值和 80%/20% 都是教学算例；不是实测注意力。
caption.en: Bicycle/weather labels, two-number values and 80%/20% weights are a teaching example, not measured attention.

beats.zh: 读“我买了自行车，周末下雨，想骑它”时，“它”与自行车有关。模型先把各处信息写成数值列表。
beats.en: In 'I bought a bicycle; it may rain; I want to ride it', it refers to the bicycle. The model represents positions as lists of numbers.

beats.zh: 模型比较当前位置与前文的数值表示，算出组合权重。这里给定80%和20%，只演示后面的乘加。
beats.en: A model compares position representations to compute mixing weights. Preset 80/20 weights here isolate the following multiplication and addition.

beats.zh: 每组数分别乘自己的权重，再把对应位置相加。交换权重后，哪部分影响更大也跟着变；结果继续参与生成。
beats.en: Multiply each value list by its weight, then add matching entries. Swapping weights changes each contribution; the combined result feeds later computation.

zh: 读“我买了自行车，周末下雨，想骑它”时，“它”与自行车有关。模型先把各处信息写成数值列表。
模型比较当前位置与前文的数值表示，算出组合权重。这里给定80%和20%，只演示后面的乘加。
每组数分别乘自己的权重，再把对应位置相加。交换权重后，哪部分影响更大也跟着变；结果继续参与生成。
刚才在增加文字序列；视觉生成还可以反复修改一个噪声状态，两种更新对象不同。
en: In 'I bought a bicycle; it may rain; I want to ride it', it refers to the bicycle. The model represents positions as lists of numbers.
A model compares position representations to compute mixing weights. Preset 80/20 weights here isolate the following multiplication and addition.
Multiply each value list by its weight, then add matching entries. Swapping weights changes each contribution; the combined result feeds later computation.
We grew a text sequence. Visual generation can instead repeatedly update a noisy state.

zh: 两组数值是[1,0]和[0,1]。本次权重0.8和0.2表示组合比例，得到[0.8,0.2]。交换权重后，数值组合也交换。真实模型中的数值由学习得到，这里把维度缩到二，是为了看见乘法与相加。
真实注意力还要根据当前查询与各位置的表示计算分数，再归一化成权重。这些组合在多层、多头中反复发生，参与形成下一步生成的表示。它不是只画一条从“它”指向自行车的线。
en: The toy values are [1,0] and [0,1]. Weights 0.8 and 0.2 combine them into [0.8,0.2]. Swapping weights changes the combination. Two dimensions make multiplication and addition visible.

Real attention computes scores from a query and position representations, then normalizes them into weights. Many layers and heads repeat such combinations to form representations used for generation.

transition.zh: 刚才在增加文字序列；视觉生成还可以反复修改一个噪声状态，两种更新对象不同。
transition.en: We grew a text sequence. Visual generation can instead repeatedly update a noisy state.

opening.zh: 前文不只是排在一起的数字。当前要继续计算时，需要组合不同位置的信息。“骑它”涉及前面的自行车，也处在天气这段语境中。注意力先比较当前位置和前文位置的数值表示，得到组合比例，再把信息按比例相加。我们只演示后面的乘加，80%和20%是给定算例。不要把这两个数当成模型对句子的固定语法规则。
opening.en: Earlier tokens are not merely a row of unrelated numbers. A position combines information from context. 'Ride it' relates to the bicycle within weather context. Attention compares position representations to compute mixing weights, then combines values. We isolate the multiplication and addition using preset 80/20 weights, not a fixed grammatical rule.

question.zh: 为什么不把前文所有信息平均一下？
question.en: Why not average all earlier information?

answer.zh: 当前位置需要的信息不同，可以给不同位置不同组合比例；平均只是所有比例相同的一种特殊情况。
answer.en: Different positions can matter differently. An average is the special case of equal mixing weights.

question.zh: 80%和20%怎么决定？
question.en: How are 80/20 weights obtained?

answer.zh: 真实注意力根据当前查询与各位置的数值表示算分数，再变成比例。本图给定比例，只展示加权运算。
answer.en: Real attention computes scores from the current query and position representations, then normalizes them. This illustration supplies weights to isolate mixing.

question.zh: 这一页怎样接到下一步？
question.en: How does this connect to the next step?

answer.zh: 刚才在增加文字序列；视觉生成还可以反复修改一个噪声状态，两种更新对象不同。
answer.en: We grew a text sequence. Visual generation can instead repeatedly update a noisy state.

demonstration.zh: 先指出句中的“它”，再走两行乘法与相加；交换一次权重，按对应项核对。
demonstration.en: Point to it, trace both products and their sum, then swap weights once.

pause.zh: 在结果出现前，让学生只计算第一项：0.8×1加0.2×0。
pause.en: Before showing the result, compute only its first entry: 0.8×1 + 0.2×0.

takeaway.zh: 注意力机制：在计算时组合上下文中不同位置的信息。
takeaway.en: Attention combines information from different context positions.

references.title: Effective context engineering for AI agents

title.zh: 文字续写与扩散去噪，更新的对象不同
title.en: Autoregressive text and diffusion update different objects

lead.zh: 自回归通常把新的片段追加到序列末尾；扩散生成则从噪声状态开始，在多个时间步用模型预测更新，逐渐形成图像。
lead.en: Autoregression appends pieces to a sequence.

key.zh: 去噪更新当前状态；自回归追加序列，两者都使用训练好的参数。
key.en: Denoising updates a state; autoregression appends a sequence. Both use learned parameters.

caption.zh: 潜空间扩散的过程示意；中间状态不是模型实测结果，解码后才是可显示图像。
caption.en: Latent-diffusion process illustration; intermediate states are not measured model output, and decoding produces the visible image.

beats.zh: 噪声是随机数形成的杂点，不是藏着一张照片。文字条件说明要画什么，例如绿色遮阳篷的咖啡店。
beats.en: Noise is a pattern of random numbers, not a hidden photograph. The text condition describes the requested café with a green awning.

beats.zh: 训练时用加噪图像学习预测噪声或更新。生成时模型读当前状态、文字与步数，给出本轮更新；这里示意为−0.20。
beats.en: Training uses noisy images to learn noise or updates. During generation the model reads state, text and timestep; −0.20 illustrates one update.

beats.zh: 按更新改变当前状态，再送回同一个模型。逐轮得到更符合条件的状态；回箭头表示继续改这份状态。
beats.en: Apply the update and feed the new state to the same model. Iteration moves it toward the condition; the return arrow carries the updated state.

beats.zh: 在这类潜空间扩散中，状态是压缩的数值表示。解码器把最终表示转为能显示的像素，才得到画面。
beats.en: In this latent-diffusion example, states are compressed numerical representations. A decoder converts the final representation into visible pixels.

zh: 自回归通常把新的片段追加到序列末尾；扩散生成则从噪声状态开始，在多个时间步用模型预测更新，逐渐形成图像。前者增加序列，后者修改当前状态。视觉模型也可以采用自回归，扩散也能用于其他模态，因此“文字只能自回归、图片只能扩散”并不成立。
两个过程都使用训练好的模型。生成时让状态改变，与训练时调整参数，是不同层面的变化。先沿箭头看状态，再问参数有没有更新。
en: Autoregression appends pieces to a sequence. Diffusion starts from a noisy state and repeatedly predicts updates that lead toward an image. One grows a sequence; the other changes a state. Vision can also be autoregressive, and diffusion can serve other modalities: these are not exclusive text/image categories.
Both use a trained model. Changing the generated state differs from changing learned parameters during training. Track the state along the arrows before asking whether the model itself changed.

zh: 噪声是随机数形成的杂点，不是藏着一张照片。文字条件说明要画什么，例如绿色遮阳篷的咖啡店。
训练时用加噪图像学习预测噪声或更新。生成时模型读当前状态、文字与步数，给出本轮更新；这里示意为−0.20。
按更新改变当前状态，再送回同一个模型。逐轮得到更符合条件的状态；回箭头表示继续改这份状态。
在这类潜空间扩散中，状态是压缩的数值表示。解码器把最终表示转为能显示的像素，才得到画面。
模型怎样更新已说明；生成作品还要把要求、候选和修改连成工作流程。
en: Noise is a pattern of random numbers, not a hidden photograph. The text condition describes the requested café with a green awning.
Training uses noisy images to learn noise or updates. During generation the model reads state, text and timestep; −0.20 illustrates one update.
Apply the update and feed the new state to the same model. Iteration moves it toward the condition; the return arrow carries the updated state.
In this latent-diffusion example, states are compressed numerical representations. A decoder converts the final representation into visible pixels.
The generation mechanism is in place. A finished artifact also needs requirements, candidates and revision.

transition.en: The generation mechanism is in place. A finished artifact also needs requirements, candidates and revision.

opening.en: Autoregression appends pieces to a sequence.

question.zh: 为什么随机噪声最后能变成咖啡店？
question.en: Why can random noise become a café?

answer.zh: 训练让模型学到图像与噪声状态、文字条件之间的关系；多轮更新利用这些学到的规律。不是噪声本身带有指定照片。
answer.en: Training learns relationships among images, noisy states and conditions; iterative updates use those learned patterns, not a photograph hidden in noise.

question.zh: −0.20这个更新怎么来？
question.en: Where does −0.20 come from?

answer.zh: 真实生成由模型根据当前状态、时间步和条件预测更新；本图给定−0.20只演示如何应用更新，不冒充模型实测值。
answer.en: A real model predicts from state, timestep and condition. This preset value isolates the arithmetic of applying an update.

question.zh: 这一页怎样接到下一步？
question.en: How does this connect to the next step?

answer.zh: 模型怎样更新已说明；生成作品还要把要求、候选和修改连成工作流程。
answer.en: The generation mechanism is in place. A finished artifact also needs requirements, candidates and revision.

demonstration.en: Show the training-noise relation, follow the gold cell through one update and return, then decode.

pause.zh: 更新前先问：这里变的是模型参数还是本次图像状态？
pause.en: Before updating, ask whether model parameters or the current image state changes.

title.zh: 一条短片，可以由多个模型接力完成
title.en: Several models can contribute to one short film

lead.zh: AIGC 指 AI 生成内容。以 15 秒咖啡店短片为例，看文字、画面与声音怎样接力。
lead.en: AIGC means AI-generated content. Follow text, visuals and audio through a 15-second café film.

key.zh: AIGC = AI-generated content，AI 生成内容。
key.en: AIGC means AI-generated content.

caption.zh: 有的模型跨多模态；有的应用组合多个专用模型。
caption.en: Some models are multimodal; applications can also combine specialized models.

beats.zh: AIGC 是 AI 生成内容的缩写。先写 15 秒短片的场景、镜头和旁白，给后面各步明确材料。
beats.en: AIGC means AI-generated content. A 15-second script specifies scenes, shots and narration for subsequent steps.

beats.zh: 画面按 0、5、10 秒排列。视频是连续的图像序列，镜头推进时，要保持咖啡店与前后画面相连。
beats.en: Visuals are ordered at 0, 5 and 10 seconds. Video is an image sequence, with café identity and motion kept continuous.

beats.zh: 声音用时间上的波形表示。把旁白放在合适的位置、调整长度，让声音和画面对齐。
beats.en: A waveform represents audio over time. Place and trim narration so its timing aligns with the visuals.

beats.zh: 剪辑把各片段排进同一条时间线，再导出完整短片。多模态指处理文字、图像或声音等不同形式的信息。
beats.en: Editing arranges clips on one timeline and exports a film. Multimodal means handling forms such as text, images and audio.

zh: AIGC 是 AI 生成内容的缩写。先写 15 秒短片的场景、镜头和旁白，给后面各步明确材料。
画面按 0、5、10 秒排列。视频是连续的图像序列，镜头推进时，要保持咖啡店与前后画面相连。
声音用时间上的波形表示。把旁白放在合适的位置、调整长度，让声音和画面对齐。

title: 文字续写与扩散去噪，更新的对象不同
Autoregressive text and diffusion update different objects
points: 文章由片段接续，图像由状态迭代的对照
paragraphs: 自回归通常把新的片段追加到序列末尾；扩散生成则从噪声状态开始，在多个时间步用模型预测更新，逐渐形成图像。前者增加序列，后者修改当前状态。视觉模型也可以采用自回归，扩散也能用于其他模态，因此“文字只能自回归、图片只能扩散”并不成立。

Autoregression appends pieces to a sequence. Diffusion starts from a noisy state and repeatedly predicts updates that lead toward an image. One grows a sequence; the other changes a state. Vision can also be autoregressive, and diffusion can serve other modalities: these are not exclusive text/image categories.
两个过程都使用训练好的模型。生成时让状态改变，与训练时调整参数，是不同层面的变化。先沿箭头看状态，再问参数有没有更新。
Both use a trained model. Changing the generated state differs from changing learned parameters during training. Track the state along the arrows before asking whether the model itself changed.

caption.zh: 潜空间扩散的过程示意；中间状态不是模型实测结果，解码后才是可显示图像。
caption.en: Latent-diffusion process illustration; intermediate states are not measured model output, and decoding produces the visible image.

beats.zh: 噪声是随机数形成的杂点，不是藏着一张照片。文字条件说明要画什么，例如绿色遮阳篷的咖啡店。
beats.en: Noise is a pattern of random numbers, not a hidden photograph. The text condition describes the requested café with a green awning.

beats.zh: 训练时用加噪图像学习预测噪声或更新。生成时模型读当前状态、文字与步数，给出本轮更新；这里示意为−0.20。
beats.en: Training uses noisy images to learn noise or updates. During generation the model reads state, text and timestep; −0.20 illustrates one update.

beats.zh: 按更新改变当前状态，再送回同一个模型。逐轮得到更符合条件的状态；回箭头表示继续改这份状态。
beats.en: Apply the update and feed the new state to the same model. Iteration moves it toward the condition; the return arrow carries the updated state.

beats.zh: 在这类潜空间扩散中，状态是压缩的数值表示。解码器把最终表示转为能显示的像素，才得到画面。
beats.en: In this latent-diffusion example, states are compressed numerical representations. A decoder converts the final representation into visible pixels.

title.en: Prompts: turn “write an article” into explicit conditions

lead.zh: 提示词是本次发给模型的任务说明。

caption.zh: 模板规定结构，实际通知提供事实；下一步把这些材料组织成上下文。
caption.en: The template specifies structure; the notice supplies facts. Next assemble the material as context.

zh: 提示词是本次发给模型的任务说明。提示词工程是反复设计和比较说明方式：目标是什么、给谁看、必须用哪些材料、按什么结构交付。模板把经常重复的要求固定下来，再填入本次主题；模板本身不会补出缺失事实。
具体写成：“面向第一次参加活动的读者，写 300 字介绍。第一段说明活动背景，第二段介绍时间、地点与参加方式。只使用下面通知中的事实。”这样，段落结构、篇幅、受众和资料范围都有了着落。模型仍需读取真正的通知，而不是只看到一句“请写得专业”。
en: A prompt states the task for the current call. Prompt engineering develops and compares task instructions: the goal, audience, material and output structure. A template fixes recurring requirements and fills in the current subject. It cannot supply missing facts by itself.

For example: “Write a 300-character introduction for first-time attendees. Paragraph one explains the background; paragraph two gives time, location and how to join. Use the supplied notice.” The structure, length, audience and evidence are explicit. The actual notice must still be supplied.

zh: 帮我写文章。；主题、受众与材料？

通知：周四 14:00；地点：报告厅；根据通知整理两段
两段结构已经清楚，但模板不会知道真实日期；把通知和相关信息送进这次上下文。
en: Write an article.; Subject, audience, material?
For first-time attendees; Paragraph 1: background; Paragraph 2: when/how to join

The structure is clear, but a template does not know the date. Supply the notice and relevant information in context.

transition.zh: 两段结构已经清楚，但模板不会知道真实日期；把通知和相关信息送进这次上下文。

question.zh: 为什么“写得专业”还不够？

answer.zh: 它没有说明受众、内容结构和事实材料。明确第一段背景、第二段活动信息，才能形成可检查要求。
answer.en: It omits audience, structure and facts. Specify background first and event details second to make the request concrete.

question.zh: 模板里哪部分每次要换？
question.en: What changes between uses of a template?

answer.zh: 主题和真实通知等材料要换；受众、段落结构与输出要求可以复用。
answer.en: The subject and actual notice change; audience, structure and output requirements can be reused.

answer.zh: 两段结构已经清楚，但模板不会知道真实日期；把通知和相关信息送进这次上下文。
answer.en: The structure is clear, but a template does not know the date. Supply the notice and relevant information in context.

lead.en: Context is what a call actually receives: instructions, relevant dialogue, the notice, retrieved passages and tool results.

caption.zh: 只画本次调用的信息组成。

beats.zh: 再选入相关对话；界面里保存的历史未必都发送。
beats.en: Select relevant conversation; stored history need not all be sent.

beats.zh: 这些信息组装为一次输入；选择和组织它们就是上下文工程。
beats.en: Assemble the input: selecting and organizing its information is context engineering.

zh: 上下文是这一次实际送入模型的内容：指令、相关对话、原始通知、检索片段、工具结果等。上下文工程决定哪些内容值得送入、怎样组织，以及空间不足时保留什么。模型参数中学到的知识、外部数据库与本次上下文是三回事；外部材料要被读取并送入，才成为这次可用的输入。
仍用活动介绍：提示词负责说“写两段”；上下文放入真实日期、地点、报名规则和受众背景。把“受众第一次参加”写得再多，也不能代替活动日期。检索增强生成 RAG 是先找相关资料，再把资料接入生成。
en: Context is what a call actually receives: instructions, relevant dialogue, the notice, retrieved passages and tool results. Context engineering selects and organizes that information within a finite window. Learned parameters, an external database and the current context are distinct. External material becomes available to a call only after it is supplied.

In the event example, the prompt asks for two paragraphs; context supplies the real date, venue, registration rules and audience background. Repeating the audience description does not replace a missing date. RAG retrieves material before including it in generation.

zh: 一次调用是把输入送给模型再接收结果。先放入要做什么的任务说明。

lead.en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) supplies relevant external passages with the question.

key.zh: 检索把外部资料接到一次生成过程里。
key.en: Retrieval connects external information to generation.

caption.zh: 示例公司的资料问答流程。RAG = retrieval-augmented generation。
caption.en: A fictional company example. RAG means retrieval-augmented generation.

beats.zh: 用户问报销最晚什么时候交。系统先用这个问题查公司制度；检索就是从资料中找相关内容。
beats.en: The user asks for an expense deadline. The system first searches company policy; retrieval finds relevant source material.

beats.zh: 检索找到“次月 5 日前提交”这一段。现在得到的是原文片段，还没有生成给用户的回答。
beats.en: Retrieval finds 'submit by the fifth of next month'. This is a source passage, not yet the generated user response.

beats.en: The app supplies the question and passage together, making this policy available to the model for the call.

beats.en: The model answers using the passage. RAG means retrieval-augmented generation: retrieve material, then generate with it.

zh: 用户问报销最晚什么时候交。系统先用这个问题查公司制度；检索就是从资料中找相关内容。
检索找到“次月 5 日前提交”这一段。现在得到的是原文片段，还没有生成给用户的回答。
应用把问题和找到的片段一起送给模型；模型本次因此读到了这条制度。
模型根据片段组织答案。RAG 是检索增强生成的缩写：先找资料，再带着资料生成。
检索只是一个工具。把读取、写入、电脑操作都拆成调用与返回，就能理解实际执行。
en: The user asks for an expense deadline. The system first searches company policy; retrieval finds relevant source material.
Retrieval finds 'submit by the fifth of next month'. This is a source passage, not yet the generated user response.
The app supplies the question and passage together, making this policy available to the model for the call.
The model answers using the passage. RAG means retrieval-augmented generation: retrieve material, then generate with it.
Retrieval is one tool. Separate file and computer operations into calls and returned observations.

zh: 让四个方框按顺序出现。检索可以用关键词，也可以用语义相似度等方法，先从文档里找出相关片段。应用把片段和问题放在一起，模型再生成回答。RAG 的全称就是 retrieval-augmented generation，检索增强生成。
这与训练的差别在位置上很直观：这里变的是放进上下文的内容。文档更新后，下次检索就可以拿到新材料。模型、文档库和应用是三个可分别变化的部分。下面把检索当作一种工具，继续看更一般的工具调用。
en: Reveal question, retrieval, context and answer. Retrieval can use keywords or semantic similarity to locate passages; the application places them beside the question.

The changing material enters context. Updating documents can change the passages retrieved next time. Model, document collection and application are separately changeable components. Retrieval is one kind of tool; now we will look at the general tool-call pattern.

transition.zh: 检索只是一个工具。把读取、写入、电脑操作都拆成调用与返回，就能理解实际执行。
transition.en: Retrieval is one tool. Separate file and computer operations into calls and returned observations.

opening.zh: 公司制度可能有几百页，但这个问题只问报销期限。把全部文件塞入输入并不是唯一方法。先让检索程序找到相关段落，再把问题和段落交给模型。检索负责找，生成负责组织成回答。这里次月5日来自左边的制度文字；换一条制度，模型本次依据的材料就会变。这个过程没有要求先把新制度重新训练进参数。
opening.en: A policy collection may span hundreds of pages while the question asks only for an expense deadline. Retrieve relevant passages before supplying the question and evidence. Retrieval finds; generation phrases an answer. The fifth of next month comes from the policy passage. A changed passage can inform a new answer without retraining it into the model.

question.zh: 为什么还需要模型，搜索不就找到了？
question.en: Why use a model after search?

answer.zh: 检索返回片段；模型可以把片段结合问题组织成直接回答。若只需打开原文，普通搜索也能完成。
answer.en: Retrieval returns passages; generation can compose a direct answer. Plain search is sufficient when opening the source is the task.

question.zh: 检索怎么知道哪段相关？
question.en: How does retrieval identify relevant passages?

answer.zh: 检索程序可比较关键词或数值表示的相似程度，再返回段落；本课不展开检索算法。
answer.en: Software can compare keywords or numerical representations and return passages. The retrieval algorithm is outside this introductory mechanism.

question.zh: 这一页怎样接到下一步？
question.en: How does this connect to the next step?

answer.zh: 检索只是一个工具。把读取、写入、电脑操作都拆成调用与返回，就能理解实际执行。
answer.en: Retrieval is one tool. Separate file and computer operations into calls and returned observations.

demonstration.zh: 依次指出问题、原文“5日”、本次输入、生成答案；用手沿答案日期追溯到原文。
demonstration.en: Trace the question through retrieval and context, then trace the answer's date back to the passage.

pause.zh: 停在检索片段：此时得到的是原文还是已经生成的回答？
pause.en: At the passage, ask whether it is source text or the generated answer.

takeaway.zh: 检索把外部资料接到一次生成过程里。
takeaway.en: Retrieval connects external information to generation.

title: 上下文：要求之外，还需要哪些信息？
Context: what information accompanies the instruction?
points: 背景知识进入本次调用
paragraphs: 上下文是这一次实际送入模型的内容：指令、相关对话、原始通知、检索片段、工具结果等。上下文工程决定哪些内容值得送入、怎样组织，以及空间不足时保留什么。模型参数中学到的知识、外部数据库与本次上下文是三回事；外部材料要被读取并送入，才成为这次可用的输入。

Context is what a call actually receives: instructions, relevant dialogue, the notice, retrieved passages and tool results. Context engineering selects and organizes that information within a finite window. Learned parameters, an external database and the current context are distinct. External material becomes available to a call only after it is supplied.
仍用活动介绍：提示词负责说“写两段”；上下文放入真实日期、地点、报名规则和受众背景。把“受众第一次参加”写得再多，也不能代替活动日期。检索增强生成 RAG 是先找相关资料，再把资料接入生成。

In the event example, the prompt asks for two paragraphs; context supplies the real date, venue, registration rules and audience background. Repeating the audience description does not replace a missing date. RAG retrieves material before including it in generation.

caption.zh: 只画本次调用的信息组成。
caption.en: The information assembled for one call.

beats.zh: 一次调用是把输入送给模型再接收结果。先放入要做什么的任务说明。
beats.en: A call sends input and receives a result. First supply the task instructions.

beats.zh: 再选入相关对话；界面里保存的历史未必都发送。
beats.en: Select relevant conversation; stored history need not all be sent.

beats.zh: 应用读出文件或工具结果，实际放入这次输入。
beats.en: The app reads files or tool results and actually supplies their content.

beats.zh: 这些信息组装为一次输入；选择和组织它们就是上下文工程。
beats.en: Assemble the input: selecting and organizing its information is context engineering.

title.zh: 调用 Word、电脑指令与 Linux，是什么意思？
title.en: What does calling Word or a Linux command mean?

lead.zh: 模型输出“把标题改成会议纪要”只是文字。
lead.en: The text “change the title” does not edit a file.

key.zh: 读、写、搜索和查询由执行器完成；结果进入下一次模型调用。
key.en: An executor reads, writes, searches and queries; observations enter the next model call.

caption.zh: 天气是流程示例，不显示实时预报。
caption.en: Weather illustrates the flow; no live forecast is shown.

beats.zh: 应用先提供可用工具说明，例如天气工具需要城市和日期。模型才知道怎样提出请求。
beats.en: The app describes available tools, including weather's city and day inputs, so the model can request a call.

beats.zh: 模型生成工具名称和所需信息。代码中的 city 是城市、day 是日期；这些叫调用参数，还不是查到的结果。
beats.en: The model produces a tool name and inputs. In the code city and day specify the request; these arguments are not the weather result.

beats.zh: 外围程序读懂这个请求，实际调用天气服务。发起网络查询的是程序，不是屏幕上的文字自己在执行。
beats.en: The surrounding program reads the request and calls the weather service. Software performs the query described by the generated text.

beats.zh: 服务返回 rain，意思是下雨。程序把结果再送入模型，模型才可以据此继续安排。
beats.en: The service returns rain. The program supplies that result to the model, which can then continue planning.

zh: 模型输出“把标题改成会议纪要”只是文字。要真正修改文件，应用须提供一个工具，例如 document.set_title；也可以提供终端工具，在 Linux 中运行已有命令。工具说明告诉模型名称、参数和用途，执行器把请求翻译成实际软件操作。工具结果随后回到模型。
同样的整理目标，Word 工具可能使用文档对象；Linux 工具可能读取文件、运行转换器或搜索文本。模型需要适应实际提供的接口。会说出命令，与命令已经执行成功，是两个不同事件。
Sandbox 是程序执行和保存工作状态的具体环境，例如一个工作目录或隔离容器。模型可以被告知“在这个项目里完成任务”，但目录、工具和执行器由软件提供。把它想成工作台更直观：有材料、有可用操作，也有每次操作产生的结果。
读文件返回原文；写文件改变工作材料；搜索从很多文件里挑出相关片段；查询数据库按条件返回记录。例如找本周待办，先 search 找到会议记录，再 read 读取上下文，最后 query database 查已有事项，write 写入整理结果。四种操作目的不同，不能用“联网”一个词全部代替。
en: The text “change the title” does not edit a file. Software must expose a tool such as document.set_title, or a terminal tool that executes a command on Linux. Tool descriptions specify names, arguments and purpose. An executor performs the operation and returns its result.

A Word tool may manipulate document objects, while a Linux tool may read files, search text or run a converter. The model must use the interface it is actually given. Producing a command and successfully executing it are separate events.

A sandbox is a concrete environment where programs execute and work is stored, such as a project directory or isolated container. Software supplies the directory, tools and executor. Think of a workbench with material, available operations and observable results.

Reading returns source text; writing changes material; search selects relevant passages; a database query returns records matching conditions. To find this week's tasks, search for notes, read their context, query existing tasks and write the result. These operations serve different purposes.

zh: 应用先提供可用工具说明，例如天气工具需要城市和日期。模型才知道怎样提出请求。
模型生成工具名称和所需信息。代码中的 city 是城市、day 是日期；这些叫调用参数，还不是查到的结果。
外围程序读懂这个请求，实际调用天气服务。发起网络查询的是程序，不是屏幕上的文字自己在执行。
服务返回 rain，意思是下雨。程序把结果再送入模型，模型才可以据此继续安排。
工具执行已接通；还要有人组织上下文、任务进度和下一轮，这些属于 Harness。
en: The app describes available tools, including weather's city and day inputs, so the model can request a call.
The model produces a tool name and inputs. In the code city and day specify the request; these arguments are not the weather result.
The surrounding program reads the request and calls the weather service. Software performs the query described by the generated text.
The service returns rain. The program supplies that result to the model, which can then continue planning.
Tools can now execute. A harness organizes context, progress and the next round.

transition.zh: 工具执行已接通；还要有人组织上下文、任务进度和下一轮，这些属于 Harness。

question.zh: city和day怎么填出来？
question.en: How are city and day filled?

answer.zh: 城市和日期来自用户目标与当前上下文，再按工具要求的字段组织；外围程序执行这一组参数。
answer.en: They come from the task and context and are arranged into the tool's input fields for software to execute.

title.zh: Harness 与 Loop：把一次生成接成连续工作
title.en: Harness and loops: connect calls into ongoing work

lead.zh: Harness 原意是把力量接到任务上的一套装置；在这里指围绕模型的软件：准备输入，描述工具，执行调用，把结果送回，并保存任务进展。
lead.en: A harness connects model capability to a task.

key.zh: Harness 连接上下文、工具、状态与循环，让一次回答接上持续工作。
key.en: A harness connects context, tools, state and loops into ongoing work.

caption.zh: 天气与工具返回均为示例；切换天气结果可查看另一条路径。
caption.en: Illustrative weather and tool results; switch the weather to see another path.

beats.zh: 目标是安排杭州周六半日活动。Agent（智能体）在这里指：模型根据当前信息提出下一步动作，程序执行后再继续。
beats.en: The goal is a Saturday half-day plan in Hangzhou. Here an agent uses a model to propose actions from current information, then continues after software executes them.

beats.zh: Harness 是围绕模型运行的程序。它先查天气，把“下雨”这条新结果放进下一次输入。
beats.en: The harness is the program around the model. It obtains weather and includes the new rain result in the next input.

beats.zh: 模型根据天气提议下一工具：雨天查场馆，晴天查公园。示意分支用于追踪信息流；仅有分支不能判定Agent。
beats.en: A model proposes a tool from weather observations. These illustrative paths expose information flow; branching alone does not establish an agent.

beats.zh: 程序接着查场馆时间或公园路线，再把结果送回。Harness/Agent 工程就是把输入、动作、结果和下一轮组织成可工作的软件。
beats.en: Software checks opening hours or a park route and returns the result. Harness/agent engineering connects inputs, actions, results and subsequent calls.

zh: Harness 原意是把力量接到任务上的一套装置；在这里指围绕模型的软件：准备输入，描述工具，执行调用，把结果送回，并保存任务进展。Agent engineering 强调把这些部件组织成能完成目标的系统。它既包括提示词，也包括文件、工具、状态和执行环境。
Loop engineering 进一步关注每一轮：根据什么继续、什么结果进入下一轮、什么时候结束，失败的尝试怎样影响后续选择。写文章时，可用“取材料→拟结构→写草稿→核对材料→修订”的循环；这里改变的是文稿和任务状态，不表示模型参数每轮都重训。下面把这个闭环拆开。
en: A harness connects model capability to a task. The software prepares input, describes tools, executes calls, returns observations and retains progress. Agent engineering organizes these parts into a goal-directed system: instructions, files, tools, state and an execution environment.

Loop engineering focuses on iteration: when to continue, what feedback to carry forward and when to stop. Writing can follow gather → outline → draft → compare with sources → revise. The draft and task state change; that does not imply retraining the model on each round. The next chapter opens this loop.

zh: 目标是安排杭州周六半日活动。Agent（智能体）在这里指：模型根据当前信息提出下一步动作，程序执行后再继续。
Harness 是围绕模型运行的程序。它先查天气，把“下雨”这条新结果放进下一次输入。
模型根据天气提议下一工具：雨天查场馆，晴天查公园。示意分支用于追踪信息流；仅有分支不能判定Agent。
程序接着查场馆时间或公园路线，再把结果送回。Harness/Agent 工程就是把输入、动作、结果和下一轮组织成可工作的软件。
知道外围程序有哪些部分后，沿一次观察、动作和反馈，看循环怎样真正推进任务。

The harness is the program around the model. It obtains weather and includes the new rain result in the next input.
A model proposes a tool from weather observations. These illustrative paths expose information flow; branching alone does not establish an agent.
Software checks opening hours or a park route and returns the result. Harness/agent engineering connects inputs, actions, results and subsequent calls.

opening.en: A harness connects model capability to a task.

question.zh: 这不就是下雨就去室内的if/else吗？
question.en: Is this just an if/else rule?

answer.zh: 单看这两条路径确实也能写成固定流程；Agent的区别是运行中由模型根据目标和观察提出工具，而不只照固定分支走。
answer.en: These two paths could indeed be coded as a workflow. An agent instead lets the model propose actions from goals and observations at runtime.

question.en: How does the observation affect the next action?

answer.zh: 天气文字进入下一次输入，模型据此生成不同工具请求；程序执行后再把开放时间或路线送回。
answer.en: Weather enters the next input, affecting the proposed tool. Software returns hours or a route for further continuation.

answer.zh: 知道外围程序有哪些部分后，沿一次观察、动作和反馈，看循环怎样真正推进任务。

What does calling Word or a Linux command mean?
points: 工具调用把模型接到实际软件
paragraphs: 模型输出“把标题改成会议纪要”只是文字。要真正修改文件，应用须提供一个工具，例如 document.set_title；也可以提供终端工具，在 Linux 中运行已有命令。工具说明告诉模型名称、参数和用途，执行器把请求翻译成实际软件操作。工具结果随后回到模型。

The text “change the title” does not edit a file. Software must expose a tool such as document.set_title, or a terminal tool that executes a command on Linux. Tool descriptions specify names, arguments and purpose. An executor performs the operation and returns its result.
同样的整理目标，Word 工具可能使用文档对象；Linux 工具可能读取文件、运行转换器或搜索文本。模型需要适应实际提供的接口。会说出命令，与命令已经执行成功，是两个不同事件。

A Word tool may manipulate document objects, while a Linux tool may read files, search text or run a converter. The model must use the interface it is actually given. Producing a command and successfully executing it are separate events.

caption.zh: 天气是流程示例，不显示实时预报。
caption.en: Weather illustrates the flow; no live forecast is shown.

beats.zh: 应用先提供可用工具说明，例如天气工具需要城市和日期。模型才知道怎样提出请求。
beats.en: The app describes available tools, including weather's city and day inputs, so the model can request a call.

beats.zh: 模型生成工具名称和所需信息。代码中的 city 是城市、day 是日期；这些叫调用参数，还不是查到的结果。
beats.en: The model produces a tool name and inputs. In the code city and day specify the request; these arguments are not the weather result.

beats.zh: 外围程序读懂这个请求，实际调用天气服务。发起网络查询的是程序，不是屏幕上的文字自己在执行。
beats.en: The surrounding program reads the request and calls the weather service. Software performs the query described by the generated text.

beats.zh: 服务返回 rain，意思是下雨。程序把结果再送入模型，模型才可以据此继续安排。
beats.en: The service returns rain. The program supplies that result to the model, which can then continue planning.

title: Sandbox：动作发生在哪里？
Sandbox: where do actions happen?
paragraphs: Sandbox 是程序执行和保存工作状态的具体环境，例如一个工作目录或隔离容器。模型可以被告知“在这个项目里完成任务”，但目录、工具和执行器由软件提供。把它想成工作台更直观：有材料、有可用操作，也有每次操作产生的结果。

A sandbox is a concrete environment where programs execute and work is stored, such as a project directory or isolated container. Software supplies the directory, tools and executor. Think of a workbench with material, available operations and observable results.
读文件返回原文；写文件改变工作材料；搜索从很多文件里挑出相关片段；查询数据库按条件返回记录。例如找本周待办，先 search 找到会议记录，再 read 读取上下文，最后 query database 查已有事项，write 写入整理结果。四种操作目的不同，不能用“联网”一个词全部代替。

Reading returns source text; writing changes material; search selects relevant passages; a database query returns records matching conditions. To find this week's tasks, search for notes, read their context, query existing tasks and write the result. These operations serve different purposes.

title: Harness 与 Loop：把一次生成接成连续工作
Harness and loops: connect calls into ongoing work
points: 围绕模型的程序与环境
paragraphs: Harness 原意是把力量接到任务上的一套装置；在这里指围绕模型的软件：准备输入，描述工具，执行调用，把结果送回，并保存任务进展。Agent engineering 强调把这些部件组织成能完成目标的系统。它既包括提示词，也包括文件、工具、状态和执行环境。

A harness connects model capability to a task. The software prepares input, describes tools, executes calls, returns observations and retains progress. Agent engineering organizes these parts into a goal-directed system: instructions, files, tools, state and an execution environment.
Loop engineering 进一步关注每一轮：根据什么继续、什么结果进入下一轮、什么时候结束，失败的尝试怎样影响后续选择。写文章时，可用“取材料→拟结构→写草稿→核对材料→修订”的循环；这里改变的是文稿和任务状态，不表示模型参数每轮都重训。下面把这个闭环拆开。

Loop engineering focuses on iteration: when to continue, what feedback to carry forward and when to stop. Writing can follow gather → outline → draft → compare with sources → revise. The draft and task state change; that does not imply retraining the model on each round. The next chapter opens this loop.

caption.zh: 天气与工具返回均为示例；切换天气结果可查看另一条路径。
caption.en: Illustrative weather and tool results; switch the weather to see another path.

beats.zh: 目标是安排杭州周六半日活动。Agent（智能体）在这里指：模型根据当前信息提出下一步动作，程序执行后再继续。
beats.en: The goal is a Saturday half-day plan in Hangzhou. Here an agent uses a model to propose actions from current information, then continues after software executes them.

beats.zh: Harness 是围绕模型运行的程序。它先查天气，把“下雨”这条新结果放进下一次输入。
beats.en: The harness is the program around the model. It obtains weather and includes the new rain result in the next input.

beats.zh: 模型根据天气提议下一工具：雨天查场馆，晴天查公园。示意分支用于追踪信息流；仅有分支不能判定Agent。
beats.en: A model proposes a tool from weather observations. These illustrative paths expose information flow; branching alone does not establish an agent.

beats.zh: 程序接着查场馆时间或公园路线，再把结果送回。Harness/Agent 工程就是把输入、动作、结果和下一轮组织成可工作的软件。
beats.en: Software checks opening hours or a park route and returns the result. Harness/agent engineering connects inputs, actions, results and subsequent calls.

title.zh: 观察、执行、反馈：自治循环怎样工作
title.en: Observation, action and feedback in an autonomous loop

lead.zh: 模型不会自动看到整台电脑。
lead.en: The model does not automatically see the entire computer.

key.zh: 模型读观察、提出动作；软件执行，再把实际变化送回。
key.en: The model receives observations and proposes actions; software executes and returns actual changes.

caption.en: Illustrative weather and tool results; switch the weather to see another path.

zh: 模型不会自动看到整台电脑。它只读取应用交给它的消息和观察。闭环是：目标进入输入，模型提出动作，软件在环境执行，执行后的观察回到下一轮。新文件、命令返回和应用状态都要通过这个入口。这里的“感知”指获得可用的观察信息。
假设目标是整理一份 Word 会议记录。第一轮只知道文件名；读文件后才有正文；提取待办后，再把写入结果送回。不能在尚未读文件时假定模型已经掌握里面的事实。上下文窗口有限，较长工作还需要把进度保存在文件或任务状态中，再有选择地读回。
自治是一个系统层面的目标：监测自身状态，根据目标调整配置或动作，再观察效果。例如服务检测到请求积压，调整工作副本，然后检查等待时间是否下降。监测负责看见变化，管理负责采取动作，优化负责在多个可行方案中改进某个指标。
许多局部闭环可以用普通程序实现；包含模型的 Agent 也只能在它实际接入的环境中行动。“完全不用人、什么都能管”的自治是更强的说法，需要明确任务范围，不能由一张有循环箭头的图直接推出。“完全自治还没有实现”应理解为对强自治愿景的讨论，不能当作所有自主系统都不存在的事实。
游戏里的非玩家角色通常称 NPC，non-player character。传统做法可以预设状态机：发现玩家就追逐，距离过远就返回。接入语言模型后，系统也可以把角色目标、可见事件和允许的动作送给模型，由它提出下一步。角色说的话和实际执行的游戏动作仍要分别处理。
例如角色说“我去拿钥匙”，游戏程序需要真正更新位置、背包和钥匙状态，下一轮再把结果交回。游戏世界的物理和规则不因此消失；这与办公 Agent 调用工具后更新文件，是同一类“语言提议→软件执行→状态反馈”的关系。
en: The model does not automatically see the entire computer. It reads messages and observations supplied by software. A closed loop sends in a goal, obtains a proposed action, executes it and returns the observation. Files, command output and application state enter through that route. Perception here means receiving usable observations.

Suppose the goal is to organize a Word meeting document. Initially there is only a filename; reading it provides the text; extracting tasks and saving them produces another observation. Longer work stores progress outside the finite context and selects what to bring back.

Autonomy is a system-level goal: monitor state, change configuration or actions toward an objective, then observe the effect. A service might detect a queue, change replicas and check waiting time. Monitoring detects; management acts; optimization improves a chosen objective among feasible alternatives.

Many local loops use conventional software. A model-based agent also acts only in its connected environment. Universal, human-free autonomy is a stronger claim and cannot be inferred from a loop diagram. A discussion of its maturity should not erase existing narrower autonomous systems.

NPC means non-player character. A conventional state machine can chase a visible player and return when too far away. A language-model system can instead supply a character goal, visible events and available actions for a proposed next step. Dialogue and executed game actions remain separate.

If a character says it will fetch a key, game software must update location, inventory and the key's state, then return the observation. World rules still exist. The same proposal → execution → state feedback pattern appears in an office agent editing a document.

zh: 目标是安排杭州周六半日活动。Agent（智能体）在这里指：模型根据当前信息提出下一步动作，程序执行后再继续。
Harness 是围绕模型运行的程序。它先查天气，把“下雨”这条新结果放进下一次输入。
模型根据天气提议下一工具：雨天查场馆，晴天查公园。示意分支用于追踪信息流；仅有分支不能判定Agent。
程序接着查场馆时间或公园路线，再把结果送回。Harness/Agent 工程就是把输入、动作、结果和下一轮组织成可工作的软件。
循环会改变外部状态；接着区分改文稿、改助手、改模型，避免把所有循环都叫自进化。
en: The goal is a Saturday half-day plan in Hangzhou. Here an agent uses a model to propose actions from current information, then continues after software executes them.
The harness is the program around the model. It obtains weather and includes the new rain result in the next input.
A model proposes a tool from weather observations. These illustrative paths expose information flow; branching alone does not establish an agent.
Software checks opening hours or a park route and returns the result. Harness/agent engineering connects inputs, actions, results and subsequent calls.
Loops change state. Distinguish artifact, assistant and model changes before calling something self-improvement.

transition.zh: 循环会改变外部状态；接着区分改文稿、改助手、改模型，避免把所有循环都叫自进化。
transition.en: Loops change state. Distinguish artifact, assistant and model changes before calling something self-improvement.

opening.zh: 模型不会自动看到整台电脑。
opening.en: The model does not automatically see the entire computer.

question.zh: 这不就是下雨就去室内的if/else吗？
question.en: Is this just an if/else rule?

answer.zh: 单看这两条路径确实也能写成固定流程；Agent的区别是运行中由模型根据目标和观察提出工具，而不只照固定分支走。
answer.en: These two paths could indeed be coded as a workflow. An agent instead lets the model propose actions from goals and observations at runtime.

question.zh: 新结果怎样影响下一步？
question.en: How does the observation affect the next action?

answer.zh: 天气文字进入下一次输入，模型据此生成不同工具请求；程序执行后再把开放时间或路线送回。
answer.en: Weather enters the next input, affecting the proposed tool. Software returns hours or a route for further continuation.

question.zh: 这一页怎样接到下一步？
question.en: How does this connect to the next step?

answer.zh: 循环会改变外部状态；接着区分改文稿、改助手、改模型，避免把所有循环都叫自进化。
answer.en: Loops change state. Distinguish artifact, assistant and model changes before calling something self-improvement.

demonstration.zh: 切换一次晴天，指天气、计划、下一工具三处同步变化。
demonstration.en: Switch to clear weather and identify changes to observation, plan and next tool.

pause.zh: 先预测晴天后该查场馆时间还是公园路线。
pause.en: Predict whether clear weather leads to opening hours or a park route.

takeaway.zh: 模型读观察、提出动作；软件执行，再把实际变化送回。

title.zh: 观察、执行、反馈：自治循环怎样工作
title.en: Observation, action and feedback in an autonomous loop

title.zh: 自进化：先看究竟改了什么

lead.zh: 一次任务循环包含目标、识别现状、制定下一步、执行和观察。
lead.en: A task loop identifies the situation, plans an action, executes and observes under a goal.

key.zh: 改文稿、改助手、改模型要分开；RSI 还要求改进能力反馈到改进机制。
key.en: Separate artifact, assistant and model changes; RSI feeds improved capability into the improvement mechanism.

caption.zh: 三类循环可以相互配合。
caption.en: These kinds of improvement can work together.

beats.zh: 改排序代码：当前成果变，模型可以不变。
beats.en: Revise sorting code: change the artifact, not necessarily the model.

beats.zh: 给助手加运行工具：以后的工作方式变。
beats.en: Add an execution tool: change future assistant behavior.

beats.zh: 训练更新参数：模型版本变。循环工程先决定反馈送回哪个对象。
beats.en: Training changes model parameters. Loop engineering locates the object receiving feedback.

zh: 一次任务循环包含目标、识别现状、制定下一步、执行和观察。下一轮可以修正文稿，也可以修改任务计划。若系统改了提示词、工具或记忆组织，是在改助手；若从训练数据更新参数，是在改模型。先明确改进对象，才能判断一次循环带来了什么。
RSI 是 recursive self-improvement：改进后的能力又参与改进产生改进的机制。例如更好的代码搜索器帮助改进下一代搜索器。它比“自己改了一次稿”要求更多，不能把重复调用、自动运行或改一个配置都叫递归自我改进。
en: A task loop identifies the situation, plans an action, executes and observes under a goal. It may revise an artifact or plan. Changing prompts, tools or memory organization changes the assistant; updating learned parameters changes the model. Identify the object before evaluating improvement.

RSI means recursive self-improvement: improved capability feeds back into improving the improvement mechanism. For example, a better code-search system helps improve its successor. Repeated calls or a single draft revision do not by themselves establish that feedback.

zh: 改排序代码：当前成果变，模型可以不变。
给助手加运行工具：以后的工作方式变。
训练更新参数：模型版本变。循环工程先决定反馈送回哪个对象。
说“改模型”之前，先看能力怎样进入系统：人工写规则，或从例子学习参数。
en: Revise sorting code: change the artifact, not necessarily the model.
Add an execution tool: change future assistant behavior.
Training changes model parameters. Loop engineering locates the object receiving feedback.
Before model improvement, examine how behavior enters a system: written rules or learned parameters.

transition.zh: 说“改模型”之前，先看能力怎样进入系统：人工写规则，或从例子学习参数。
transition.en: Before model improvement, examine how behavior enters a system: written rules or learned parameters.

question.zh: 为什么都叫改进还要分开？
question.en: Why distinguish improvements?

answer.zh: 三者改变的对象不同，决定了改善只影响这次结果，还是后续工具能力，或者模型版本。
answer.en: The changed object determines whether the effect concerns this artifact, future tools or a model version.

question.zh: 怎样识别变化发生在哪里？
question.en: How do we identify the level?

answer.zh: 看最终保存的是什么：新代码、助手程序配置，还是一套新模型参数。
answer.en: Inspect what is saved: a code artifact, assistant software configuration or model parameters.

question.zh: 这一页怎样接到下一步？
question.en: How does this connect to the next step?

answer.zh: 说“改模型”之前，先看能力怎样进入系统：人工写规则，或从例子学习参数。
answer.en: Before model improvement, examine how behavior enters a system: written rules or learned parameters.

pause.zh: 问改排序代码属于哪一列。

title: 游戏角色：有规则的世界也可以接模型
Game characters can combine world rules and models
points: 预定义系统与模型动态行为的对照
paragraphs: 游戏里的非玩家角色通常称 NPC，non-player character。传统做法可以预设状态机：发现玩家就追逐，距离过远就返回。接入语言模型后，系统也可以把角色目标、可见事件和允许的动作送给模型，由它提出下一步。角色说的话和实际执行的游戏动作仍要分别处理。

NPC means non-player character. A conventional state machine can chase a visible player and return when too far away. A language-model system can instead supply a character goal, visible events and available actions for a proposed next step. Dialogue and executed game actions remain separate.
例如角色说“我去拿钥匙”，游戏程序需要真正更新位置、背包和钥匙状态，下一轮再把结果交回。游戏世界的物理和规则不因此消失；这与办公 Agent 调用工具后更新文件，是同一类“语言提议→软件执行→状态反馈”的关系。

If a character says it will fetch a key, game software must update location, inventory and the key's state, then return the observation. World rules still exist. The same proposal → execution → state feedback pattern appears in an office agent editing a document.

title: 自进化：先看究竟改了什么
Self-improvement: identify what changed
points: 改答案、改系统与改模型的区别
paragraphs: 一次任务循环包含目标、识别现状、制定下一步、执行和观察。下一轮可以修正文稿，也可以修改任务计划。若系统改了提示词、工具或记忆组织，是在改助手；若从训练数据更新参数，是在改模型。先明确改进对象，才能判断一次循环带来了什么。

A task loop identifies the situation, plans an action, executes and observes under a goal. It may revise an artifact or plan. Changing prompts, tools or memory organization changes the assistant; updating learned parameters changes the model. Identify the object before evaluating improvement.
RSI 是 recursive self-improvement：改进后的能力又参与改进产生改进的机制。例如更好的代码搜索器帮助改进下一代搜索器。它比“自己改了一次稿”要求更多，不能把重复调用、自动运行或改一个配置都叫递归自我改进。

RSI means recursive self-improvement: improved capability feeds back into improving the improvement mechanism. For example, a better code-search system helps improve its successor. Repeated calls or a single draft revision do not by themselves establish that feedback.

caption.zh: 三类循环可以相互配合。
caption.en: These kinds of improvement can work together.

beats.zh: 改排序代码：当前成果变，模型可以不变。
beats.en: Revise sorting code: change the artifact, not necessarily the model.

beats.zh: 给助手加运行工具：以后的工作方式变。
beats.en: Add an execution tool: change future assistant behavior.

beats.zh: 训练更新参数：模型版本变。循环工程先决定反馈送回哪个对象。
beats.en: Training changes model parameters. Loop engineering locates the object receiving feedback.

lead.zh: LLM 是大语言模型，但理解它可以先看更广的 AI 两条路线：一条由人明确写规则和知识；另一条用带参数的计算网络，从样本中学习输入到输出的关系。
lead.en: To understand LLMs, compare two broader AI approaches.

caption.zh: 同一类问题可以组合规则、检索和学习。
caption.en: Rules, retrieval and learning can be combined.

zh: LLM 是大语言模型，但理解它可以先看更广的 AI 两条路线：一条由人明确写规则和知识；另一条用带参数的计算网络，从样本中学习输入到输出的关系。它们不是一条完全替代另一条的单线历史；现代应用常把确定性规则、检索和学习模型放在一起。
语法规则可以写“名词＋动词＋宾语”这样的结构；学习系统则从大量句子中调整参数，以处理许多不容易逐条写完的语言关系。规则便于逐条检查，学习方法适合从例子归纳；选哪一种要看任务，而不是把“没有 if/else”当成智能的定义。
知识图谱把实体和关系显式保存成节点与连线，例如“皇帝—别称—皇上”。它能支持检索、规则推导和实体关联。语法关注句子怎样组成，语义关注表达的含义；翻译还要处理语境、语序和指代，所以一个同义词关系不足以完成整句翻译。
专家系统把某个领域的知识和推理规则写入程序。例如“设备温度高且风扇停转→检查散热”。规则覆盖不到的新情况，需要补充规则或其他模型。“人工”强调知识组织需要人的工作；这与神经网络从训练样本调整参数，是不同的知识进入方式。
en: To understand LLMs, compare two broader AI approaches. One explicitly encodes rules and knowledge; another learns input-output relationships in a parameterized network. This is not a simple history in which one entirely replaces the other. Applications often combine rules, retrieval and learned models.

A grammar can encode an explicit sentence structure. A learned system adjusts parameters across examples to handle many language relationships. Rules can be inspected individually; learning generalizes from examples. The absence of if/else is not a definition of intelligence.

A knowledge graph explicitly stores entities and relationships, such as emperor → alternative name → sovereign. It supports lookup and rule-based inference. Syntax concerns structure; semantics concerns meaning. Translation also involves context, order and reference, so a synonym link alone does not translate a sentence.

An expert system encodes domain knowledge and inference rules—for example, high temperature plus a stopped fan suggests checking cooling. New situations may need new rules or another model. Human knowledge engineering and learning parameters from examples are different ways of introducing knowledge.

zh: 温度高 + 风扇停；→ 检查散热
皇帝 → 别称 → 皇上；显式实体与关系
规则和学习已经分开；现在实际算一个线性关系与神经元，让参数不再只是名字。
en: Hot + fan stopped; → inspect cooling
Emperor → alias → sovereign; Explicit entities and links
Having separated rules and learning, compute a linear relationship and neuron so parameters become concrete.

title.zh: 规则路线与连接学习路线
从 y=ax+b 到一个神经元

lead.zh: 设 x 是路程，y 是费用，a 是每公里费用，b 是起步费。
lead.en: Let x be distance, y be fare, a be cost per kilometre and b a starting charge.

key.zh: y=ax+b 先说明参数；加权和加非线性，再组合成更复杂的函数。
key.en: Use y=ax+b to introduce parameters, then weighted sums and nonlinearities for richer functions.

beats.zh: 先固定两个输入和权重。权重控制每个输入怎样影响结果。
beats.en: Fix two inputs and weights; each weight determines an input's contribution.
Add 2×0.5 and 1×0.2 plus zero bias to obtain 1.2.

beats.zh: ReLU 取和与 0 中较大者。把第一个输入改为负数，观察输出怎样改变。
beats.en: ReLU takes the maximum of the sum and zero. Change the first input to a negative value and compare.

caption.zh: 两输入、单神经元的教学算例；真实模型由大量算子组合。
caption.en: A two-input, one-neuron teaching example; real models compose many operations.

zh: 设 x 是路程，y 是费用，a 是每公里费用，b 是起步费。记录是 1 公里 5 元、2 公里 7 元、3 公里 9 元。用 a=1、b=2 预测，会得到 3、4、5；用 a=2、b=3 则得到 5、7、9。学习就是利用记录，找到让整体误差更小的参数，而不是为每一个输入单独写答案。
一条直线只能表达有限关系。若真实关系会弯曲、取决于多种条件，就需要更多特征或更复杂的模型。只把许多线性层堆在一起仍可能等价于一个线性变换；神经网络还使用非线性运算，才能表达更复杂的组合。
一个简化神经元先把输入乘权重，再加偏置，最后做非线性变换。例如输入是 [2,1]、权重是 [0.5,0.2]、偏置为 0，得到 2×0.5+1×0.2=1.2；再用 ReLU，取 max(0,1.2)=1.2。若和为负，ReLU 输出 0，这个折点就是非线性。
许多层把这些操作组合起来。训练时调整权重，推理时使用当前权重。网络连线表示计算依赖，不等于“某条连线就是某条事实”；知识图谱中明确写出的实体关系，与模型中分散在参数里的统计关系，需要分开理解。
en: Let x be distance, y be fare, a be cost per kilometre and b a starting charge. Records (1,5), (2,7), (3,9) disagree with a=1,b=2, which predicts 3,4,5. Parameters a=2,b=3 predict 5,7,9. Learning uses examples to reduce overall error instead of storing one separate answer for every input.

A line has limited expressive power. Curved or conditional relationships require more features or a richer model. Stacking linear transformations alone can remain equivalent to one linear map; neural networks also use nonlinear operations.

A simple neuron multiplies inputs by weights, adds a bias and applies a nonlinearity. With input [2,1], weights [0.5,0.2] and zero bias, the sum is 1.2. ReLU outputs max(0,1.2)=1.2; a negative sum would produce zero. That bend makes it nonlinear.

Layers compose these operations. Training changes weights; inference uses them. A connection represents a computational dependency, not necessarily one stored fact. Explicit graph relations differ from statistical relationships distributed across learned parameters.

ReLU 取和与 0 中较大者。把第一个输入改为负数，观察输出怎样改变。
神经网络内部的计算模块，与多个完整 Agent 是不同层面；现在看系统怎样拆任务协作。
en: Fix two inputs and weights; each weight determines an input's contribution.
Add 2×0.5 and 1×0.2 plus zero bias to obtain 1.2.
ReLU takes the maximum of the sum and zero. Change the first input to a negative value and compare.
Neural computation modules differ from complete agents. Now examine task-level coordination.

question.en: Why add a nonlinearity?

answer.zh: 单纯叠加线性变换仍可合成线性变换；非线性让多层组合表达更复杂关系。
answer.en: Linear maps compose into another linear map. Nonlinearities let layers express richer relationships.

question.zh: 1.2 怎样算出来？
question.en: Where does 1.2 come from?

answer.en: 2×0.5+1×0.2+0=1.2. With first input −2, the sum is −0.8 and ReLU outputs zero.

zh: 多 Agent 系统把工作分给多个有各自任务状态的执行者。它们可以调用同一个模型服务，也可以使用不同模型。真正需要说明的是分工、可见资料、交付格式与谁负责合并。单个模型内部有多个专家模块的 MoE，则是另一层结构。
做产品比较时，三个 Agent 分别查价格、功能与使用限制，协调者合成同一张比较表。只有任务能独立推进时才有并行收益；资料重复、相互依赖和最后整合都可能增加时间。多几个 Agent 不会自动补齐缺失证据，也不自动构成自我改进。
en: A multi-agent system assigns work to executors with separate task states. They may share a model service or use different models. Explain assignments, available information, handoff format and synthesis. MoE experts inside one model are a different architectural layer.

For a product comparison, agents can investigate price, features and constraints, then a coordinator combines results. Parallelism helps independent work; duplication, dependencies and synthesis add time. More agents do not automatically supply missing evidence or establish self-improvement.

answer.zh: 原来三个任务的时间相加；同时开始后只等最长任务，再加整合。

title.zh: 数据怎样进入训练，参数怎样计数

lead.zh: 训练语料可以包含网页、书籍、代码等材料。
lead.en: Training material may include web pages, books and code.

key.zh: 语料变成 Token 序列；K、M、B、T 数参数，Byte 数存储。
key.en: Corpora become token sequences. K/M/B/T count parameters; bytes measure storage.

beats.zh: 文本 → Token 序列；前文 → 真实后续；样本用于调整参数
beats.en: Text → token sequences; Prefix → observed next; Examples update parameters

beats.zh: K = 10³；M = 10⁶；B = 10⁹；T = 10¹²；B 不等于 Byte
beats.en: K = 10³; M = 10⁶; B = 10⁹; T = 10¹²; B does not mean byte

caption.zh: Token 数量、参数数量和存储空间，是不同的量。
caption.en: Token counts, parameter counts and storage are different quantities.

zh: 训练语料可以包含网页、书籍、代码等材料。准备数据要处理格式、重复和质量，再按分词器转成 Token 序列。板书用“一个字一个字”帮助想象，但模型真正学习的是 Token；一次训练还可同时计算序列中多个位置的预测损失。
假设把“离离原上草”分成五个字：有了前两个“离”，下一个目标是“原”；有了“离离原”，下一个目标是“上”。同一段材料能形成多个前文与后续的学习位置。实际切分不一定正好五个 Token。
参数是训练中可以调整的数，例如权重和偏置。K=10³=一千，M=10⁶=一百万，B=10⁹=十亿，T=10¹²=一万亿。因此 35B 是 350 亿参数，2.8T 是 2.8 万亿。B 在这里是 billion 的缩写；Byte 是存储单位，不能混读。
数量说明有多少个可存储的数，却没有说明每个数占多少位、训练用了多少数据、一次实际激活多少参数，或任务能做多好。后面会分别把数量接到内存计算和 MoE 激活。
en: Training material may include web pages, books and code. Preparation handles format, duplication and quality before tokenization. “Character by character” is an intuition: the actual units are tokens, and training can calculate losses at many sequence positions together.
Assume the line 离离原上草 is split by character. Given 离离, the next target is 原; given 离离原, it is 上. One passage supplies several learning positions. A real tokenizer may choose a different split.

Parameters are adjustable values such as weights and biases. K=10³, M=10⁶, B=10⁹ and T=10¹². Thus 35B means 35 billion and 2.8T means 2.8 trillion parameters. B here abbreviates billion; a byte is a storage unit.
A count does not specify bits per value, training data, parameters active per token or task quality. Later sections connect counts to memory and MoE activation.

K = 10³；M = 10⁶；B = 10⁹；T = 10¹²；B 不等于 Byte
数据与参数的计数清楚了，再看训练材料和信号怎样按阶段变化。

K = 10³; M = 10⁶; B = 10⁹; T = 10¹²; B does not mean byte

transition.en: With data and parameter counts clear, examine how curricula and signals change across training stages.

question.en: Why turn a corpus into tokens?

answer.zh: 分词器把内容转成模型可处理的序列；Token 不固定等于一个汉字。
answer.en: A tokenizer produces a sequence for the model. A token need not equal one Chinese character.

question.zh: 35B 是 35 GB 吗？
question.en: Does 35B mean 35 GB?

answer.zh: 不是。B 表示十亿，35B 是 350 亿个参数；空间还要乘每个参数的表示大小。
answer.en: No. B means billion: 35 billion parameters. Storage also depends on bytes per parameter.

answer.en: With data and parameter counts clear, examine how curricula and signals change across training stages.

title.zh: 数据怎样进入训练，参数怎样计数
预训练、中训练与后训练

lead.zh: 预训练用较广泛的数据学习语言、代码和其他规律。
lead.en: Pretraining learns patterns from broad material through repeated prediction and updates.

key.zh: 广泛学习、集中学习和任务行为塑造，改变的是数据与训练信号。
key.en: Broad learning, focused curricula and task shaping change data and training signals.

beats.zh: 广泛文本与代码；学习一般模式
beats.en: Broad text and code; Learn broad patterns

beats.zh: 集中材料或目标；例如长上下文、领域
beats.en: Focused data or objectives; E.g. long context or domain

beats.zh: 示范、偏好与奖励；塑造任务行为
beats.en: Examples, preferences, rewards; Shape task behavior

caption.zh: 中训练并非统一必经阶段；RLHF 是后训练方法之一。
caption.en: Mid-training is not a universal required phase; RLHF is one post-training method.

zh: 预训练用较广泛的数据学习语言、代码和其他规律。把它比作“早读”，重点是从很多材料反复预测和调整。模型不是先被写入一套完整语法，再只用训练背知识；这些关系都可以在参数学习中形成。
“中训练”常指在基础模型上继续安排特定的数据或训练目标，例如更高质量的专业材料、代码、长上下文任务。它不是每个团队都严格采用的统一阶段名。“精读”说明学习材料与重点更集中，不能只根据这个词推断具体训练配方。
后训练在已有模型上塑造任务行为。SFT 提供示范：给定通知，怎样整理成表格；偏好数据提供比较：两个答案里哪个更符合要求。RLHF 是 reinforcement learning from human feedback，用人类反馈形成奖励信号，再用强化学习调整策略的一类方法。
例如两份纪要，一份漏了截止日期，另一份保留日期且结构清楚。偏好反馈可以支持更符合任务的行为，但“人更喜欢”与“每个事实都正确”仍是不同评价。后训练也可能使用自动检查、可验证奖励等方法，不是每一次更新都由一个人逐字打分。
en: Pretraining learns patterns from broad material through repeated prediction and updates. The reading analogy emphasizes exposure across examples rather than a complete hand-written grammar followed by fact memorization.

Mid-training often means continuing a base model with focused data or objectives, such as specialist material, code or long-context tasks. It is not a universally standardized phase. The close-reading analogy highlights a changed curriculum, not a specific training recipe.

Post-training shapes task behavior in an existing model. SFT supplies demonstrations, while preference data compares possible answers. RLHF—reinforcement learning from human feedback—uses human feedback to form a reward signal for policy training.

Two meeting summaries may differ in whether a deadline is retained and clearly organized. Preference feedback can favor the more useful behavior, while factual correctness remains a separate property. Post-training can also use automatic checks or verifiable rewards; humans need not score every update word by word.

示范、偏好与奖励；塑造任务行为
这些阶段会更新参数；把它与使用已有参数回答本次问题区分开。

question.en: Does every model require mid-training?

answer.zh: 这个名称没有统一的必经定义，常指基础模型上的集中数据或目标训练。
answer.en: It is not a universal required phase; it often refers to focused data or objectives after base training.

question.zh: RLHF 怎样用人类反馈？
question.en: How does RLHF use human feedback?

answer.en: Feedback helps form rewards for reinforcement learning; humans need not score every update word by word.

title.zh: 预训练、中训练与后训练
训练改本领，推理用本领
title.en: Training develops the model; inference uses it

lead.zh: 训练：调整参数。推理：用训练好的参数处理这一次输入。
lead.en: Training adjusts parameters. Inference uses learned parameters on this input.

key.zh: 参数与当前上下文，是两种不同的东西。
key.en: Learned parameters and current context are different things.

caption.zh: 微调指在已有模型上继续训练；贴入文件是提供上下文。
caption.en: Fine-tuning continues training from an existing model; supplying a document provides context.

beats.zh: 训练用许多已知输入和目标的例子，反复预测、比较、调参数。学好的参数保存成一个模型版本。
beats.en: Training repeatedly predicts, compares and adjusts using examples with known targets. Learned parameters are saved as a model version.

beats.zh: 推理就是使用这个版本处理新输入。贴一份新文件后能回答，是因为这次读到了文件，通常没有因此改变参数。
beats.en: Inference uses that version on new input. A supplied document can inform a response because it is in context, usually without changing parameters.

zh: 训练用许多已知输入和目标的例子，反复预测、比较、调参数。学好的参数保存成一个模型版本。
推理就是使用这个版本处理新输入。贴一份新文件后能回答，是因为这次读到了文件，通常没有因此改变参数。
学过不等于会处理新题；保留评测任务，检查学到的能力能否迁移。
en: Training repeatedly predicts, compares and adjusts using examples with known targets. Learned parameters are saved as a model version.
Inference uses that version on new input. A supplied document can inform a response because it is in context, usually without changing parameters.
Learning examples does not prove transfer. Hold tasks out to check performance beyond training.

zh: 左边是训练，像学习阶段；右边是推理，像用已经学到的能力处理新问题。把一份新文件贴进去，模型本次能讨论它，是因为文件在当前输入里。
微调是基于已有模型继续训练，调整参数或适配器。应用记忆通常是把偏好存下来，以后检索回上下文。长对话、检索结果、缓存，以及多想一会儿，都可以发生在使用模型的过程中。
en: Contrast the learning stage with using learned abilities. A new document is usable because it is supplied in the current input.

Fine-tuning continues training, adjusting parameters or adapters. Application memory usually stores information and retrieves it into later context. Conversation, retrieval, caches and longer reasoning can all occur while using a trained model.

transition.zh: 学过不等于会处理新题；保留评测任务，检查学到的能力能否迁移。
transition.en: Learning examples does not prove transfer. Hold tasks out to check performance beyond training.

opening.zh: 把学好的 a、b 保存，就能估算新路程的费用。训练调整参数；推理使用已有参数处理这次输入。
opening.en: Save learned a and b to estimate a new journey's fare. Training changes parameters; inference uses learned parameters on the current input.

question.zh: 为什么贴了新文件就能答，却不是训练？
question.en: Why can a new file help without training?

answer.zh: 已有能力处理了这次输入，参数版本未因此更新；就像会算乘法的人读到一张新订单。
answer.en: Existing capabilities process new input without changing the model version, like applying multiplication to a new order.

question.zh: 微调和检索分别改变哪里？
question.en: What do fine-tuning and retrieval change?

answer.zh: 微调继续调整模型参数；检索把找到的材料加入本次输入。两条路径可以配合，但不是同一步。
answer.en: Fine-tuning changes parameters; retrieval supplies material to context. They can combine but are different operations.

question.zh: 这一页怎样接到下一步？
question.en: How does this connect to the next step?

answer.zh: 学过不等于会处理新题；保留评测任务，检查学到的能力能否迁移。
answer.en: Learning examples does not prove transfer. Hold tasks out to check performance beyond training.

demonstration.zh: 先指训练列的参数更新，再指推理列的新输入；用刚讲过的路程与费用接回 a、b。
demonstration.en: Point to parameter updates, then new input; reconnect to the journey/fare example with a and b.

pause.zh: 让听众把“贴新文件”和“重新调参数”分别放进两列。
pause.en: Place supplying a file and updating parameters in the appropriate columns.

takeaway.zh: 参数与当前上下文，是两种不同的东西。
takeaway.en: Learned parameters and current context are different things.

instruction.en: Keep the worked example and mechanism.

title.zh: 训练改本领，推理用本领
title.en: Training develops the model; inference uses it

title.zh: 学习与考试：为什么要把题目留出来？
title.en: Learning and exams: why hold examples out?

lead.zh: 训练会用样本更新参数；测试用于观察学过以后能否处理未用于这次训练的例子。
lead.en: Training updates parameters from examples.

key.zh: 训练题用来学习；保留题用来观察能否迁移，并核对参考答案。
key.en: Train on examples, evaluate transfer on held-out tasks and check reference answers.

beats.zh: 先定义三个任务及完成条件，不先决定哪个品牌胜出。
beats.en: Define tasks and completion conditions before comparing brands.

beats.zh: 保持任务条件一致，把模型、工具与执行看作一个候选系统。
beats.en: Keep task conditions comparable and treat model, tools and execution as one candidate.

beats.zh: 本例三个任务中完成两个，完成率为 2/3；仍保留未完成的那一项和时间、用量。
beats.en: The teaching example completes two of three tasks. Keep the failed item, time and usage alongside 2/3 completion.

caption.zh: 合成评分样例，不是任何实际产品的评测结果。
caption.en: Synthetic scoring example, not measured product performance.

zh: 训练会用样本更新参数；测试用于观察学过以后能否处理未用于这次训练的例子。如果只用刚训练过的原题考试，就分不清记住材料与迁移能力。Benchmark 是一组有任务、输入和评分规则的评测，不只是一个排行榜分数。
大模型可以帮忙出题、构造反例或改写题目，但要核对参考答案，保留未参与调参的题，避免把生成题的错误一并带入。比较两个编程助手时，也要说明使用了什么工具、时间与尝试次数；否则分数可能在比较不同考试条件。
en: Training updates parameters from examples. Evaluation checks behavior on examples withheld from that training. Testing only on rehearsed answers confuses memorization with transfer. A benchmark is a set of tasks, inputs and scoring rules, not just a leaderboard number.

A model can propose questions or counterexamples, but answers and scoring still need checking, and some tasks should remain unused in tuning. Comparing coding assistants also requires describing tools, time and attempts; otherwise the scores may compare different exam conditions.

zh: 先定义三个任务及完成条件，不先决定哪个品牌胜出。
保持任务条件一致，把模型、工具与执行看作一个候选系统。
本例三个任务中完成两个，完成率为 2/3；仍保留未完成的那一项和时间、用量。
考试怎样评分已清楚；回到训练，拿真实后续与预测分布比较，计算一次损失。
en: Define tasks and completion conditions before comparing brands.
Keep task conditions comparable and treat model, tools and execution as one candidate.
The teaching example completes two of three tasks. Keep the failed item, time and usage alongside 2/3 completion.
After scoring evaluation tasks, return to training and compare observed continuations with predicted probabilities.

transition.zh: 考试怎样评分已清楚；回到训练，拿真实后续与预测分布比较，计算一次损失。
transition.en: After scoring evaluation tasks, return to training and compare observed continuations with predicted probabilities.

question.zh: 为什么不只考训练过的原题？
question.en: Why not test only rehearsed examples?

answer.zh: 那样难以区分记忆与迁移；保留题用于观察未参与这次训练的任务表现。
answer.en: That confuses memorization with transfer. Held-out tasks examine behavior beyond the training examples.

question.zh: 完成率怎么算？
question.en: How is completion calculated?

answer.zh: 按事先规定的条件逐项核对，三项里完成两项就是 2/3；仍保留失败项、时间和用量。
answer.en: Score each task against the predefined rubric. Two of three is 2/3; retain failures, time and usage.

question.zh: 这一页怎样接到下一步？
question.en: How does this connect to the next step?

answer.zh: 考试怎样评分已清楚；回到训练，拿真实后续与预测分布比较，计算一次损失。
answer.en: After scoring evaluation tasks, return to training and compare observed continuations with predicted probabilities.

demonstration.zh: 先读三条评分条件，再运行，再逐项标出两项完成、一项未完成。
demonstration.en: Read the three rubrics, run the candidate, then mark two completed tasks and one failure.

pause.zh: 在 2/3 处停住，指出这个数没有解释失败原因。
pause.en: Hold at 2/3 and point out that the aggregate does not explain the failure.

opening.zh: 训练会用样本更新参数；测试用于观察学过以后能否处理未用于这次训练的例子。
opening.en: Training updates parameters from examples.

takeaway.zh: 训练题用来学习；保留题用来观察能否迁移，并核对参考答案。
takeaway.en: Train on examples, evaluate transfer on held-out tasks and check reference answers.
