title.zh: 学习与考试：为什么要把题目留出来？
title.en: Learning and exams: why hold examples out?

title: 互联网数据，不是逐字抄进一个资料柜
Internet data is not copied character by character into a filing cabinet
points: 一个字一个字学的直观说法
paragraphs: 训练语料可以包含网页、书籍、代码等材料。准备数据要处理格式、重复和质量，再按分词器转成 Token 序列。板书用“一个字一个字”帮助想象，但模型真正学习的是 Token；一次训练还可同时计算序列中多个位置的预测损失。

Training material may include web pages, books and code. Preparation handles format, duplication and quality before tokenization. “Character by character” is an intuition: the actual units are tokens, and training can calculate losses at many sequence positions together.
假设把“离离原上草”分成五个字：有了前两个“离”，下一个目标是“原”；有了“离离原”，下一个目标是“上”。同一段材料能形成多个前文与后续的学习位置。实际切分不一定正好五个 Token。
Assume the line 离离原上草 is split by character. Given 离离, the next target is 原; given 离离原, it is 上. One passage supplies several learning positions. A real tokenizer may choose a different split.

beats.zh: 文本 → Token 序列；前文 → 真实后续；样本用于调整参数
beats.en: Text → token sequences; Prefix → observed next; Examples update parameters

beats.zh: K = 10³；M = 10⁶；B = 10⁹；T = 10¹²；B 不等于 Byte
beats.en: K = 10³; M = 10⁶; B = 10⁹; T = 10¹²; B does not mean byte

caption.zh: Token 数量、参数数量和存储空间，是不同的量。
caption.en: Token counts, parameter counts and storage are different quantities.

title: 参数数量里的 K、M、B、T
K, M, B and T in parameter counts
paragraphs: 参数是训练中可以调整的数，例如权重和偏置。K=10³=一千，M=10⁶=一百万，B=10⁹=十亿，T=10¹²=一万亿。因此 35B 是 350 亿参数，2.8T 是 2.8 万亿。B 在这里是 billion 的缩写；Byte 是存储单位，不能混读。

Parameters are adjustable values such as weights and biases. K=10³, M=10⁶, B=10⁹ and T=10¹². Thus 35B means 35 billion and 2.8T means 2.8 trillion parameters. B here abbreviates billion; a byte is a storage unit.
数量说明有多少个可存储的数，却没有说明每个数占多少位、训练用了多少数据、一次实际激活多少参数，或任务能做多好。后面会分别把数量接到内存计算和 MoE 激活。
A count does not specify bits per value, training data, parameters active per token or task quality. Later sections connect counts to memory and MoE activation.

title: 预训练与中训练：广泛阅读，再集中学习
Pretraining and mid-training: broad exposure, then a focused curriculum
points: 广泛数据与集中材料的区别
paragraphs: 预训练用较广泛的数据学习语言、代码和其他规律。把它比作“早读”，重点是从很多材料反复预测和调整。模型不是先被写入一套完整语法，再只用训练背知识；这些关系都可以在参数学习中形成。

Pretraining learns patterns from broad material through repeated prediction and updates. The reading analogy emphasizes exposure across examples rather than a complete hand-written grammar followed by fact memorization.
“中训练”常指在基础模型上继续安排特定的数据或训练目标，例如更高质量的专业材料、代码、长上下文任务。它不是每个团队都严格采用的统一阶段名。“精读”说明学习材料与重点更集中，不能只根据这个词推断具体训练配方。

Mid-training often means continuing a base model with focused data or objectives, such as specialist material, code or long-context tasks. It is not a universally standardized phase. The close-reading analogy highlights a changed curriculum, not a specific training recipe.

beats.zh: 广泛文本与代码；学习一般模式
beats.en: Broad text and code; Learn broad patterns

beats.zh: 集中材料或目标；例如长上下文、领域
beats.en: Focused data or objectives; E.g. long context or domain

beats.zh: 示范、偏好与奖励；塑造任务行为
beats.en: Examples, preferences, rewards; Shape task behavior

caption.zh: 中训练并非统一必经阶段；RLHF 是后训练方法之一。
caption.en: Mid-training is not a universal required phase; RLHF is one post-training method.

title: 后训练与 RLHF：把会续写接到会完成任务
Post-training and RLHF: move from continuation to task behavior
points: 从人类反馈中强化学习
paragraphs: 后训练在已有模型上塑造任务行为。SFT 提供示范：给定通知，怎样整理成表格；偏好数据提供比较：两个答案里哪个更符合要求。RLHF 是 reinforcement learning from human feedback，用人类反馈形成奖励信号，再用强化学习调整策略的一类方法。

Post-training shapes task behavior in an existing model. SFT supplies demonstrations, while preference data compares possible answers. RLHF—reinforcement learning from human feedback—uses human feedback to form a reward signal for policy training.
例如两份纪要，一份漏了截止日期，另一份保留日期且结构清楚。偏好反馈可以支持更符合任务的行为，但“人更喜欢”与“每个事实都正确”仍是不同评价。后训练也可能使用自动检查、可验证奖励等方法，不是每一次更新都由一个人逐字打分。

Two meeting summaries may differ in whether a deadline is retained and clearly organized. Preference feedback can favor the more useful behavior, while factual correctness remains a separate property. Post-training can also use automatic checks or verifiable rewards; humans need not score every update word by word.

title: 训练改本领，推理用本领
Training develops the model; inference uses it
paragraphs: 把学好的 a、b 保存，就能估算新路程的费用。训练调整参数；推理使用已有参数处理这次输入。
Save learned a and b to estimate a new journey's fare. Training changes parameters; inference uses learned parameters on the current input.
参数与当前上下文，是两种不同的东西。
Learned parameters and current context are different things.

caption.zh: 微调指在已有模型上继续训练；贴入文件是提供上下文。
caption.en: Fine-tuning continues training from an existing model; supplying a document provides context.

beats.zh: 训练用许多已知输入和目标的例子，反复预测、比较、调参数。学好的参数保存成一个模型版本。
beats.en: Training repeatedly predicts, compares and adjusts using examples with known targets. Learned parameters are saved as a model version.

beats.zh: 推理就是使用这个版本处理新输入。贴一份新文件后能回答，是因为这次读到了文件，通常没有因此改变参数。
beats.en: Inference uses that version on new input. A supplied document can inform a response because it is in context, usually without changing parameters.

concepts: 换输入和改参数是两种不同变化。
Changing input and changing parameters are different.

title: 学习与考试：为什么要把题目留出来？
Learning and exams: why hold examples out?
points: 结果对标准与反例核验
paragraphs: 训练会用样本更新参数；测试用于观察学过以后能否处理未用于这次训练的例子。如果只用刚训练过的原题考试，就分不清记住材料与迁移能力。Benchmark 是一组有任务、输入和评分规则的评测，不只是一个排行榜分数。

Training updates parameters from examples. Evaluation checks behavior on examples withheld from that training. Testing only on rehearsed answers confuses memorization with transfer. A benchmark is a set of tasks, inputs and scoring rules, not just a leaderboard number.
大模型可以帮忙出题、构造反例或改写题目，但要核对参考答案，保留未参与调参的题，避免把生成题的错误一并带入。比较两个编程助手时，也要说明使用了什么工具、时间与尝试次数；否则分数可能在比较不同考试条件。

A model can propose questions or counterexamples, but answers and scoring still need checking, and some tasks should remain unused in tuning. Comparing coding assistants also requires describing tools, time and attempts; otherwise the scores may compare different exam conditions.

beats.zh: 先定义三个任务及完成条件，不先决定哪个品牌胜出。
beats.en: Define tasks and completion conditions before comparing brands.

beats.zh: 保持任务条件一致，把模型、工具与执行看作一个候选系统。
beats.en: Keep task conditions comparable and treat model, tools and execution as one candidate.

beats.zh: 本例三个任务中完成两个，完成率为 2/3；仍保留未完成的那一项和时间、用量。
beats.en: The teaching example completes two of three tasks. Keep the failed item, time and usage alongside 2/3 completion.

caption.en: Synthetic scoring example, not measured product performance.

references.title: Learning to Summarize from Human Feedback
Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
HELM: Holistic Evaluation of Language Models

title.en: 12 SFT, RL, loss, reward and advantage

title.zh: 候选概率与正确目标，不是同一列数
title.en: Candidate probabilities and a target are different quantities

lead.zh: 假设四个候选的预测概率是 [0.6,0.1,0.2,0.1]，总和为 1，而真实后续落在第三项“原”。
lead.en: Suppose four candidate probabilities are [0.6,0.1,0.2,0.1] and the observed continuation 原 is candidate three.

key.en: Observed next token 原: probability 0.2→0.6, negative log loss 1.609→0.511.

steps.zh: 目标概率提高，损失降低

beats.zh: 给定前文“离离”，本例真实后续是“原”，为四个候选中的第三项。
beats.en: Given prefix 离离, the observed next item 原 is candidate three.
The prediction is [0.6,0.1,0.2,0.1]; target [0,0,1,0] marks the observed item.

beats.zh: 本例把“原”的概率从 0.2 调到 0.6，其负对数损失从 1.609 降到 0.511；总概率一直为 1。
beats.en: The toy update raises 原 from 0.2 to 0.6, lowering negative log loss from 1.609 to 0.511 while probabilities sum to one.

caption.zh: 概率与更新为教学设定，不是模型实测；更新展示目标，不模拟完整梯度训练。
caption.en: Illustrative probabilities and update, not a model measurement or full gradient training.

zh: 假设四个候选的预测概率是 [0.6,0.1,0.2,0.1]，总和为 1，而真实后续落在第三项“原”。目标可用 [0,0,1,0] 表示，意思是“这一次实际出现第三项”，不是又一组模型猜测。训练会根据目标计算损失，推动参数改变。
ln 表示自然对数。负对数把很小的目标概率变成较大损失；目标概率为 1 时，损失为 0。只看本位置的负对数概率：原的概率为 0.2，损失是 −ln(0.2)≈1.609；若调整后为 0.6，损失变为约 0.511。动画中的其他候选也同步调整以保持总和为 1。这是教学数值，不是对诗句做的模型实测。
en: Suppose four candidate probabilities are [0.6,0.1,0.2,0.1] and the observed continuation 原 is candidate three. A target [0,0,1,0] marks that observation. It is not another model guess. Training computes a loss from this target and updates parameters.

ln denotes the natural logarithm. Negative log probability assigns larger loss to smaller target probabilities; probability one gives zero loss. For this position, negative log probability is −ln(0.2)≈1.609. Raising the target's probability to 0.6 lowers it to about 0.511. The animation adjusts other candidates so probabilities still sum to one. These are teaching values, not measured model outputs.

zh: 给定前文“离离”，本例真实后续是“原”，为四个候选中的第三项。
本例把“原”的概率从 0.2 调到 0.6，其负对数损失从 1.609 降到 0.511；总概率一直为 1。
有了数值训练目标，再分清示范输出和结果奖励两种信号如何组织学习。
en: Given prefix 离离, the observed next item 原 is candidate three.
The prediction is [0.6,0.1,0.2,0.1]; target [0,0,1,0] marks the observed item.
The toy update raises 原 from 0.2 to 0.6, lowering negative log loss from 1.609 to 0.511 while probabilities sum to one.
With a numerical objective in place, distinguish demonstrated outputs from outcome rewards.

transition.zh: 有了数值训练目标，再分清示范输出和结果奖励两种信号如何组织学习。
transition.en: With a numerical objective in place, distinguish demonstrated outputs from outcome rewards.

question.en: Why is the target [0,0,1,0]?

answer.zh: 本例真实出现第三个候选“原”；这个向量标记观察，不是另一组模型猜测。
answer.en: The observed next item 原 is candidate three. The vector marks that observation, not another model guess.

question.en: How does 1.609 become 0.511?

answer.en: The target probability rises from 0.2 to 0.6: −ln(0.2)≈1.609, −ln(0.6)≈0.511. Other probabilities adjust so the sum stays one.

question.zh: 这一页怎样接到下一步？
question.en: How does this connect to the next step?

answer.zh: 有了数值训练目标，再分清示范输出和结果奖励两种信号如何组织学习。
answer.en: With a numerical objective in place, distinguish demonstrated outputs from outcome rewards.

demonstration.en: Read observed 原, align candidates with the one-hot target, then animate probability and loss.

pause.zh: 让听众先找到第三项，再读 −ln(0.2)。
pause.en: Locate candidate three before reading −ln(0.2).

opening.en: Suppose four candidate probabilities are [0.6,0.1,0.2,0.1] and the observed continuation 原 is candidate three.

title.zh: 候选概率与正确目标，不是同一列数

title.zh: SFT 给示范，RL 看结果
title.en: SFT learns demonstrations; RL learns from outcomes

lead.zh: SFT 是 supervised fine-tuning，监督微调。
lead.en: SFT is supervised fine-tuning.

key.zh: SFT 学示范输出；RL 根据结果反馈学习，工程与科学都能组合使用。
key.en: SFT learns demonstrated outputs; RL learns from outcome feedback. Both can serve engineering and science.

lines.zh: 生成程序 → 运行测试
结果评分 → 学习信号

beats.zh: 输入：会议原文；目标：事项／人／日期；学习示范输出的概率
beats.en: Input: meeting transcript; Target: task / owner / date; Learn demonstrated output

beats.zh: 输入：编程问题；生成程序 → 运行测试；结果评分 → 学习信号
beats.en: Input: coding problem; Generate → execute tests; Outcome score → learning

caption.zh: 两种信号都能用于工程与科学；粘贴范例不等于更新参数。
caption.en: Both signals serve engineering and science; pasting an example is not a parameter update.

zh: SFT 是 supervised fine-tuning，监督微调。数据包含输入和希望模型给出的示范输出；训练增加这类输出在相应输入下的概率。例如把会议原文与正确的事项表组成样本，模型学习按指定字段整理。示范可以有多种合理写法，并非所有任务都只有唯一一句标准答案。
把 SFT 比作“工程、标答案”，是因为训练信号比较明确。真正训练仍需大量样本、损失计算和参数更新；在对话里贴一份正确答案，只是让它成为上下文示例，不能直接等同于完成 SFT。
RL 是 reinforcement learning，强化学习。系统尝试动作或生成完整回答，再根据结果得到奖励信号，用它改变以后行为的倾向。例如一道编程题，不先提供整份程序，只运行测试：通过多少测试可作为奖励的一部分。百分比是评分的一个可能形式，具体奖励如何定义取决于任务。
把 RL 比作“科学探索”，是因为没有现成的完整解法，但可以观察结果。这不表示 SFT 只用于工程、RL 只用于科学；两者是训练信号的不同组织方式，实际系统经常组合使用。
en: SFT is supervised fine-tuning. Training pairs an input with a demonstrated output and increases the probability of that behavior under the input. Meeting text paired with a correct task table teaches the desired fields. A task may have several valid demonstrations, not one unique sentence.

The engineering analogy highlights a relatively explicit target. Training still requires examples, loss computation and parameter updates. Pasting one good answer into a conversation supplies an in-context example; it is not itself SFT.

RL is reinforcement learning. The system tries actions or generates an answer, receives an outcome score and learns to favor more successful behavior. For a programming task, tests can score a generated program without first supplying the complete solution. A percentage is one possible scoring scheme, not the definition of RL.

The science analogy emphasizes exploration with observable outcomes rather than a complete prescribed solution. SFT is not restricted to engineering, nor RL to science; practical systems can combine both kinds of signal.

question.zh: SFT 是否只适合有唯一答案的题？
question.en: Does SFT require one unique answer?

answer.zh: 不需要；可以有多种合理示范。关键是训练样本给出期望输出，而非仅有结果分数。
answer.en: No. Several demonstrations may be valid. The key is supplying demonstrated outputs rather than only outcome scores.

question.zh: 测试通过率怎样成为奖励？
question.en: How can test success become reward?

answer.zh: 先运行生成的程序，再按通过比例或其他任务规则形成数值反馈；评分设计决定学到什么。
answer.en: Execute the program, then form feedback from test results or another task rubric. Reward design shapes what is learned.

question.zh: 这一页怎样接到下一步？
question.en: How does this connect to the next step?

answer.zh: 结果奖励还不是优化中的全部比较；减去基线能看出这次表现相对好在哪里。
answer.en: Outcome reward is not the whole learning comparison. A baseline reveals relative performance.

demonstration.zh: 左边给纪要及示范表；右边不给完整程序，只运行测试评分。
demonstration.en: On the left provide a summary demonstration; on the right run tests without supplying the complete program.

pause.zh: 请听众指出：哪边直接给期望输出，哪边评价尝试的结果。
pause.en: Ask which side supplies an output and which scores an attempt.

title.zh: SFT 给示范，RL 看结果
title.en: SFT learns demonstrations; RL learns from outcomes
What do loss, reward and advantage compare?

lead.zh: Loss 是优化时要降低的数值目标。
lead.en: Loss is a numerical objective minimized during optimization.

key.zh: 奖励 1、0，基线 0.5，优势 +0.5、−0.5；奖励、优势、优化损失各有用途。
key.en: Rewards 1/0, baseline 0.5, advantages +0.5/−0.5: reward, advantage and loss have distinct roles.

steps.zh: 用相对表现影响策略更新

beats.zh: 任务要求保留截止日期。先看两个回答到底保留了什么。
beats.en: The task requires a deadline. Compare what each answer retained.

beats.zh: 本例保留日期得 1 分，遗漏日期得 0 分；这是明确规定的教学评分。
beats.en: This toy rubric awards 1 for retaining the date and 0 for omitting it.
With mean reward 0.5 as baseline, advantages are +0.5 and −0.5.

beats.zh: 正优势提供鼓励该行为的学习信号，负优势提供相反信号；真正算法还包含其他项。
beats.en: Positive advantage supports favoring the behavior; negative advantage provides the opposite signal. Real algorithms add further terms.

caption.zh: 组均值基线是教学例子；奖励、优势与优化损失不是同一个数。
caption.en: A group-mean baseline illustrates the idea; reward, advantage and loss are distinct.

zh: Loss 是优化时要降低的数值目标。语言预测常用目标 Token 的负对数概率：预测越不支持真实后续，损失越大。Reward 是任务或偏好给出的结果评价，通常希望更高。二者用途不同，不能看到一个分数下降就认定任务做得更好。
Advantage 比较某次结果与基线预期。教学例子：两个回答奖励是 1 和 0，以组内均值 0.5 作基线，优势就是 +0.5 和 −0.5。策略更新可提高相对较好回答的倾向，降低相对较差的倾向；实际算法还包含其他项。这里的组均值是一个示例基线，不是所有 RL 方法的唯一公式。
en: Loss is a numerical objective minimized during optimization. Next-token training can use negative log probability of the actual continuation. Reward evaluates an outcome and is generally maximized. A lower arbitrary score does not automatically mean better task performance.

Advantage compares an outcome with a baseline. In a toy group with rewards 1 and 0, mean 0.5 gives advantages +0.5 and −0.5. A policy update can favor relatively better behavior, with further terms in real algorithms. The group mean is one illustrative baseline, not the universal RL definition.

zh: 任务要求保留截止日期。先看两个回答到底保留了什么。
本例保留日期得 1 分，遗漏日期得 0 分；这是明确规定的教学评分。
正优势提供鼓励该行为的学习信号，负优势提供相反信号；真正算法还包含其他项。
现在知道一轮训练的信号，再把视角放大：数据、模型和总计算预算怎样共同分配？
en: The task requires a deadline. Compare what each answer retained.
This toy rubric awards 1 for retaining the date and 0 for omitting it.
With mean reward 0.5 as baseline, advantages are +0.5 and −0.5.
Positive advantage supports favoring the behavior; negative advantage provides the opposite signal. Real algorithms add further terms.
Having explained one learning signal, widen the view to data, model size and total compute allocation.

transition.zh: 现在知道一轮训练的信号，再把视角放大：数据、模型和总计算预算怎样共同分配？
transition.en: Having explained one learning signal, widen the view to data, model size and total compute allocation.

question.zh: 为什么奖励还要减基线？
question.en: Why subtract a baseline from reward?

answer.zh: 优势表达相对预期的好坏；本例用组均值作基线，真实方法也可采用其他基线。
answer.en: Advantage expresses performance relative to expectation. The group mean is one illustrative baseline among several possibilities.

question.zh: 两个优势怎样算？
question.en: How are the two advantages computed?

question.zh: 这一页怎样接到下一步？
question.en: How does this connect to the next step?

answer.zh: 现在知道一轮训练的信号，再把视角放大：数据、模型和总计算预算怎样共同分配？
answer.en: Having explained one learning signal, widen the view to data, model size and total compute allocation.

demonstration.zh: 对照保留日期和漏掉日期的回答，给 1、0 分，再减均值 0.5。
demonstration.en: Compare retained and omitted deadlines, award 1/0 and subtract the 0.5 mean.

title.en: What do loss, reward and advantage compare?

title: 候选概率与正确目标，不是同一列数
Candidate probabilities and a target are different quantities
points: 真实后续提供训练目标
网络连接输出候选分数
paragraphs: 假设四个候选的预测概率是 [0.6,0.1,0.2,0.1]，总和为 1，而真实后续落在第三项“原”。目标可用 [0,0,1,0] 表示，意思是“这一次实际出现第三项”，不是又一组模型猜测。训练会根据目标计算损失，推动参数改变。

Suppose four candidate probabilities are [0.6,0.1,0.2,0.1] and the observed continuation 原 is candidate three. A target [0,0,1,0] marks that observation. It is not another model guess. Training computes a loss from this target and updates parameters.
ln 表示自然对数。负对数把很小的目标概率变成较大损失；目标概率为 1 时，损失为 0。只看本位置的负对数概率：原的概率为 0.2，损失是 −ln(0.2)≈1.609；若调整后为 0.6，损失变为约 0.511。动画中的其他候选也同步调整以保持总和为 1。这是教学数值，不是对诗句做的模型实测。

ln denotes the natural logarithm. Negative log probability assigns larger loss to smaller target probabilities; probability one gives zero loss. For this position, negative log probability is −ln(0.2)≈1.609. Raising the target's probability to 0.6 lowers it to about 0.511. The animation adjusts other candidates so probabilities still sum to one. These are teaching values, not measured model outputs.

steps.zh: 目标概率提高，损失降低

beats.zh: 给定前文“离离”，本例真实后续是“原”，为四个候选中的第三项。
beats.en: Given prefix 离离, the observed next item 原 is candidate three.
The prediction is [0.6,0.1,0.2,0.1]; target [0,0,1,0] marks the observed item.

beats.zh: 本例把“原”的概率从 0.2 调到 0.6，其负对数损失从 1.609 降到 0.511；总概率一直为 1。
beats.en: The toy update raises 原 from 0.2 to 0.6, lowering negative log loss from 1.609 to 0.511 while probabilities sum to one.

caption.zh: 概率与更新为教学设定，不是模型实测；更新展示目标，不模拟完整梯度训练。
caption.en: Illustrative probabilities and update, not a model measurement or full gradient training.

title: SFT：从示范答案学习怎么做
SFT: learn behavior from demonstrations
points: 工程中的有明确目标的学习
paragraphs: SFT 是 supervised fine-tuning，监督微调。数据包含输入和希望模型给出的示范输出；训练增加这类输出在相应输入下的概率。例如把会议原文与正确的事项表组成样本，模型学习按指定字段整理。示范可以有多种合理写法，并非所有任务都只有唯一一句标准答案。

SFT is supervised fine-tuning. Training pairs an input with a demonstrated output and increases the probability of that behavior under the input. Meeting text paired with a correct task table teaches the desired fields. A task may have several valid demonstrations, not one unique sentence.
把 SFT 比作“工程、标答案”，是因为训练信号比较明确。真正训练仍需大量样本、损失计算和参数更新；在对话里贴一份正确答案，只是让它成为上下文示例，不能直接等同于完成 SFT。

The engineering analogy highlights a relatively explicit target. Training still requires examples, loss computation and parameter updates. Pasting one good answer into a conversation supplies an in-context example; it is not itself SFT.

title: RL：答案未知，也能用结果反馈学习
RL: learn from outcomes without a demonstrated answer
points: 正负反馈、百分比式评分
paragraphs: RL 是 reinforcement learning，强化学习。系统尝试动作或生成完整回答，再根据结果得到奖励信号，用它改变以后行为的倾向。例如一道编程题，不先提供整份程序，只运行测试：通过多少测试可作为奖励的一部分。百分比是评分的一个可能形式，具体奖励如何定义取决于任务。

RL is reinforcement learning. The system tries actions or generates an answer, receives an outcome score and learns to favor more successful behavior. For a programming task, tests can score a generated program without first supplying the complete solution. A percentage is one possible scoring scheme, not the definition of RL.
把 RL 比作“科学探索”，是因为没有现成的完整解法，但可以观察结果。这不表示 SFT 只用于工程、RL 只用于科学；两者是训练信号的不同组织方式，实际系统经常组合使用。

The science analogy emphasizes exploration with observable outcomes rather than a complete prescribed solution. SFT is not restricted to engineering, nor RL to science; practical systems can combine both kinds of signal.

title: Loss、Reward、Advantage，分别在比较什么？
What do loss, reward and advantage compare?
paragraphs: Loss 是优化时要降低的数值目标。语言预测常用目标 Token 的负对数概率：预测越不支持真实后续，损失越大。Reward 是任务或偏好给出的结果评价，通常希望更高。二者用途不同，不能看到一个分数下降就认定任务做得更好。

Loss is a numerical objective minimized during optimization. Next-token training can use negative log probability of the actual continuation. Reward evaluates an outcome and is generally maximized. A lower arbitrary score does not automatically mean better task performance.
Advantage 比较某次结果与基线预期。教学例子：两个回答奖励是 1 和 0，以组内均值 0.5 作基线，优势就是 +0.5 和 −0.5。策略更新可提高相对较好回答的倾向，降低相对较差的倾向；实际算法还包含其他项。这里的组均值是一个示例基线，不是所有 RL 方法的唯一公式。

Advantage compares an outcome with a baseline. In a toy group with rewards 1 and 0, mean 0.5 gives advantages +0.5 and −0.5. A policy update can favor relatively better behavior, with further terms in real algorithms. The group mean is one illustrative baseline, not the universal RL definition.

title.zh: 13 Scaling Law：数据、参数与推理计算
title.en: 13 Scaling laws: data, parameters and inference compute

title.zh: Scaling Law：三种“变大”不能混在一起
title.en: Scaling laws: distinguish three kinds of growth

lead.zh: Scaling Law 是对一组训练实验观察到的规律：在相近任务、数据与训练方法下，模型规模、训练数据和计算预算与预测损失之间常呈现可拟合关系。
lead.en: Scaling laws describe empirical relationships between prediction loss, model size, training data and compute under comparable experimental conditions.

key.zh: 固定预算时，模型规模 N 与数据 D 要一起分配；越大越好需要条件。
key.en: Under fixed compute, allocate model scale N and data D together; bigger requires conditions.

steps.zh: 固定 N×D 的示意预算
增大 N，也要减少 D
比较同预算下的玩具损失
steps.en: Compare toy losses at equal budget

beats.zh: N 表示相对模型规模，D 表示相对训练数据量；本图固定 N×D=16。
beats.en: N is relative model scale and D relative data; this example fixes N×D=16.

beats.zh: 选择不同 N，观察 D=16/N 同步变化。模型更大不是免费增加计算。
beats.en: Change N and observe D=16/N. Larger models are not a free compute increase.

beats.zh: 玩具损失 N^−0.5+D^−0.5 在本例均衡分配时更低。真实最优点需要实际训练实验。
beats.en: Toy loss N^−0.5+D^−0.5 is lower at a balanced allocation here. Real optima require training experiments.

caption.zh: 无量纲玩具函数，只说明预算分配，不用于预测真实模型质量。
caption.en: Dimensionless toy function for allocation, not a predictor of real model quality.

zh: Scaling Law 是对一组训练实验观察到的规律：在相近任务、数据与训练方法下，模型规模、训练数据和计算预算与预测损失之间常呈现可拟合关系。这里的“越大”至少有参数数量、训练 Token 数和总计算量三个维度，不是单独把其中一个拉满就一定最好。
固定训练预算时，更大模型通常意味着每个 Token 更贵，能处理的数据可能更少。图中把 N×D 固定，尝试分配给模型规模 N 和数据量 D。显示的是一条明确标注的玩具损失函数，用来解释资源分配；它不是任何真实模型的能力预测器。
en: Scaling laws describe empirical relationships between prediction loss, model size, training data and compute under comparable experimental conditions. “Bigger” has several dimensions: parameters, training tokens and computation. Maximizing one alone is not a universal optimum.

At fixed compute, a larger model costs more per token and may see less data. The diagram holds N×D constant and varies model scale N against data D. Its explicitly labeled toy loss demonstrates allocation; it does not predict the capability of a real model.

zh: N 表示相对模型规模，D 表示相对训练数据量；本图固定 N×D=16。
选择不同 N，观察 D=16/N 同步变化。模型更大不是免费增加计算。
玩具损失 N^−0.5+D^−0.5 在本例均衡分配时更低。真实最优点需要实际训练实验。
训练预算决定形成怎样的模型；模型完成训练后，还能在单个任务上增加推理计算。
en: N is relative model scale and D relative data; this example fixes N×D=16.
Change N and observe D=16/N. Larger models are not a free compute increase.
Toy loss N^−0.5+D^−0.5 is lower at a balanced allocation here. Real optima require training experiments.
Training allocation forms the model. Afterwards, a single task can receive additional inference compute.

transition.zh: 训练预算决定形成怎样的模型；模型完成训练后，还能在单个任务上增加推理计算。
transition.en: Training allocation forms the model. Afterwards, a single task can receive additional inference compute.

question.zh: 为什么不能只把模型做大？
question.en: Why not maximize model size alone?

answer.zh: 固定预算下，每个 Token 更贵会挤掉数据或其他计算；规模规律需要数据、模型和预算条件。
answer.en: At fixed compute, higher cost per token leaves less data or other work. Scaling depends on model, data and budget together.

question.zh: 图里的最小值怎样得到？
question.en: Where does the toy minimum come from?

answer.zh: D=16/N，代入 N^−0.5+D^−0.5；本例 N=D=4 时损失为 1。它不是实测能力曲线。

zh: “脑容量”只能帮助想象可调整数很多，不能把参数个数换算成人的智力。更直接的工程问题是：多少个数、每个数占多少位。作为可核查例子，Kimi K3 技术报告给出 2.8T 总参数、104B 激活参数；若仅用 16 位保存 2.8T 个数，原始权重就是 2.8×10¹²×2≈5.6 TB。

title.zh: 芯片与算力：存得下，还要算得动、传得快
title.en: Chips and compute: fit, calculate and communicate

lead.zh: GPU 可并行处理大量相似运算，但性能取决于多件事：计算单元做乘加的速度，显存能存多少，数据怎样从显存搬到计算单元，以及多卡怎样交换数据。
lead.en: GPUs perform similar operations in parallel, but performance depends on arithmetic, memory capacity, data movement and communication.

key.zh: 容量决定存多少，带宽决定搬多快，计算单元执行运算。
key.en: Capacity stores, bandwidth moves data and compute units perform arithmetic.

caption.zh: 三个概念分别对应容量、带宽、计算能力。
caption.en: Capacity, bandwidth and compute describe different aspects.

beats.zh: GPU 是擅长大量相似运算的处理器。显存是它旁边用来存数字的空间，放模型参数和运行数据；容量常用 GB 表示。
beats.en: A GPU is a processor suited to many similar operations. Device memory holds parameters and working data; capacity is commonly measured in GB.

beats.zh: 计算单元要先拿到数字。带宽是每秒能搬多少数据，常用 GB/s；空间大与搬得快是两个指标。
beats.en: Compute units must receive the numbers. Bandwidth measures data moved per second, often GB/s; capacity and movement rate are different.

beats.zh: 输入[2,3]、[1,4]都与参数[5,4]逐项相乘相加，独立得到22、21。GPU并行做许多这类计算。
beats.en: Inputs [2,3] and [1,4] use shared parameters [5,4] to produce independent sums 22 and 21; GPUs parallelize many such operations.

zh: GPU 可并行处理大量相似运算，但性能取决于多件事：计算单元做乘加的速度，显存能存多少，数据怎样从显存搬到计算单元，以及多卡怎样交换数据。显存容量像工作台面积，带宽像搬运速度，计算能力像同时工作的计算单元数量。
“上万个芯片、十万卡”说明系统规模可以很大，不是某个指定模型的最低要求。小模型可以在一台设备上运行，大规模训练则可能用大集群。卡数增加还会增加通信和调度成本，最终速度要从完成的实际工作量测量。
en: GPUs perform similar operations in parallel, but performance depends on arithmetic, memory capacity, data movement and communication. Capacity is workspace; bandwidth moves data; compute performs operations. One figure cannot replace all three.

Thousands-of-chips or hundred-thousand-card examples illustrate possible system scale, not a minimum for every model. Small models can run on one device; large training may use clusters. More cards also introduce communication and coordination cost; speed must be measured from completed work.

zh: GPU 是擅长大量相似运算的处理器。显存是它旁边用来存数字的空间，放模型参数和运行数据；容量常用 GB 表示。
计算单元要先拿到数字。带宽是每秒能搬多少数据，常用 GB/s；空间大与搬得快是两个指标。
输入[2,3]、[1,4]都与参数[5,4]逐项相乘相加，独立得到22、21。GPU并行做许多这类计算。
减少每个数的位数可以减少存储和搬运，但要实际观察数值近似产生的误差。
en: A GPU is a processor suited to many similar operations. Device memory holds parameters and working data; capacity is commonly measured in GB.
Compute units must receive the numbers. Bandwidth measures data moved per second, often GB/s; capacity and movement rate are different.
Inputs [2,3] and [1,4] use shared parameters [5,4] to produce independent sums 22 and 21; GPUs parallelize many such operations.
Reducing bits can save storage and movement. Observe the numerical approximation and its errors.

transition.zh: 减少每个数的位数可以减少存储和搬运，但要实际观察数值近似产生的误差。
transition.en: Reducing bits can save storage and movement. Observe the numerical approximation and its errors.

opening.zh: GPU 可并行处理大量相似运算，但性能取决于多件事：计算单元做乘加的速度，显存能存多少，数据怎样从显存搬到计算单元，以及多卡怎样交换数据。
opening.en: GPUs perform similar operations in parallel, but performance depends on arithmetic, memory capacity, data movement and communication.

question.zh: 为什么AI经常用GPU，不只用CPU？
question.en: Why use GPUs rather than only CPUs?

answer.zh: 模型有大量可重复、可并行的乘加运算，GPU适合这类组织；CPU仍负责很多控制和准备工作。
answer.en: Models contain many similar parallel multiply-add operations; CPUs still handle control and preparation.

question.zh: 图里的22和21怎么来？
question.en: How are twenty-two and twenty-one obtained?

answer.zh: 两行输入分别为[2,3]和[1,4]，都与参数[5,4]对应相乘后相加，得到22和21。
answer.en: Inputs [2,3] and [1,4] each multiply corresponding entries of parameters [5,4] and sum the products.

question.zh: 这一页怎样接到下一步？
question.en: How does this connect to the next step?

answer.zh: 减少每个数的位数可以减少存储和搬运，但要实际观察数值近似产生的误差。
answer.en: Reducing bits can save storage and movement. Observe the numerical approximation and its errors.

pause.en: Before the results, ask whether either row needs the other's answer.

takeaway.en: Capacity stores, bandwidth moves data and compute units perform arithmetic.

title.zh: 从 FP16、FP8 到 4 位量化
title.en: From FP16 and FP8 to 4-bit quantization

lead.zh: 8 bit 等于 1 Byte。
lead.en: Eight bits equal one byte.

key.zh: FP16 每值 2 Byte；降低位数减少存储，但舍入、截断与任务表现都要比较。
key.en: FP16 uses two bytes per value. Fewer bits save storage; compare rounding, clipping and task outcomes.

steps.zh: 除步长、取整并限制编码范围

beats.zh: 先读三个原始权重。存储位数减少后，可表示的档位也会减少。
beats.en: Read three original weights. Fewer bits provide fewer representable levels.

beats.zh: 本例用有符号 4 位整数 −8…7 编码。除以步长、四舍五入，再限制到这个范围。
beats.en: This example uses signed 4-bit integer codes −8…7: divide by the step, round and clip to range.

beats.zh: 整数码乘回步长得到近似值。改变步长，比较舍入误差与超范围截断；实际量化还可按组设计。
beats.en: Multiply codes by the step to reconstruct approximations. Change the step to compare rounding and clipping; real quantizers can work by groups.

caption.zh: 教学均匀量化器；不是所有 FP8、FP4 或实际模型的量化方法。
caption.en: A toy uniform quantizer, not the definition of every FP8/FP4 format or model quantizer.

zh: 8 bit 等于 1 Byte。FP16 每个值占 16 bit，即 2 Byte；FP8 通常每个值占 1 Byte；4 bit 的紧凑编码理论上每 Byte 可放两个值。FP 指浮点格式；INT4 与 FP4 都可以是 4 位，但数值编码不同，不能把它们当成同一种格式。
对 35B 个权重，原始位数粗算分别是 70 GB、35 GB 和 17.5 GB，采用十进制 GB。量化文件还可能附带缩放系数、分组信息与较高精度部分，所以实际文件不是只按这一行乘法；运行内存还要再加缓存和工作空间。
量化把原来较精细的数映射到有限档位。教学例子用步长 0.25，把 [1.23,−0.78,0.41] 四舍五入到整数码 [5,−3,2]，再乘 0.25 重建为 [1.25,−0.75,0.50]。三个误差分别为 +0.02、+0.03、+0.09。实际方法可按组选择不同缩放系数，这里只看映射与误差怎样出现。
把小数写短可以帮助理解“表示更粗”，但量化不等于把所有小数统一截掉几位。它减少存储与搬运需求，是否更快还取决于硬件和内核，是否影响结果则要回到原任务集测。不能从“位数减半”直接推出“答案质量不变且速度翻倍”。
en: Eight bits equal one byte. FP16 uses two bytes per value; FP8 uses one; tightly packed 4-bit values allow two per byte. FP denotes floating point. INT4 and FP4 both use four bits but have different numerical encodings.

For 35B weights, decimal raw sizes are about 70 GB, 35 GB and 17.5 GB. Quantized files may also contain scales, grouping metadata and higher-precision components. Runtime memory adds caches and workspace.

Quantization maps fine-grained values onto a finite set. With toy step 0.25, [1.23,−0.78,0.41] becomes integer codes [5,−3,2] and reconstructs to [1.25,−0.75,0.50]. Errors are +0.02,+0.03,+0.09. Real methods can use group-specific scales; this example exposes the mapping.

Shorter decimals illustrate coarser representation, but quantization is not simply trimming a fixed number of decimal places. It reduces storage and movement; speed depends on hardware and kernels, while quality must be checked on tasks. Half the bits does not guarantee twice the speed with unchanged answers.

question.en: Why does 4-bit storage save space?

answer.en: Each value uses four bits, ideally two per byte. Real formats also store scaling metadata and higher-precision parts.

question.zh: 步长 0.125 为什么截断？
question.en: Why does step 0.125 clip?

answer.en: 1.23/0.125≈9.84 rounds to 10, exceeding signed 4-bit maximum 7, so reconstruction is 7×0.125=0.875.

pause.en: Hold at 1.23→0.875 and explain why a smaller step produced more error.

opening.en: Eight bits equal one byte.

takeaway.en: FP16 uses two bytes per value. Fewer bits save storage; compare rounding, clipping and task outcomes.

title.zh: 从 FP16、FP8 到 4 位量化
title.en: From FP16 and FP8 to 4-bit quantization

title: 芯片与算力：存得下，还要算得动、传得快
Chips and compute: fit, calculate and communicate
points: 芯片（上万个）的规模想象
算力（十万卡）的规模想象
大模型依赖计算与硬件系统
paragraphs: GPU 可并行处理大量相似运算，但性能取决于多件事：计算单元做乘加的速度，显存能存多少，数据怎样从显存搬到计算单元，以及多卡怎样交换数据。显存容量像工作台面积，带宽像搬运速度，计算能力像同时工作的计算单元数量。

GPUs perform similar operations in parallel, but performance depends on arithmetic, memory capacity, data movement and communication. Capacity is workspace; bandwidth moves data; compute performs operations. One figure cannot replace all three.
“上万个芯片、十万卡”说明系统规模可以很大，不是某个指定模型的最低要求。小模型可以在一台设备上运行，大规模训练则可能用大集群。卡数增加还会增加通信和调度成本，最终速度要从完成的实际工作量测量。

Thousands-of-chips or hundred-thousand-card examples illustrate possible system scale, not a minimum for every model. Small models can run on one device; large training may use clusters. More cards also introduce communication and coordination cost; speed must be measured from completed work.

caption.zh: 三个概念分别对应容量、带宽、计算能力。
caption.en: Capacity, bandwidth and compute describe different aspects.

beats.zh: GPU 是擅长大量相似运算的处理器。显存是它旁边用来存数字的空间，放模型参数和运行数据；容量常用 GB 表示。
beats.en: A GPU is a processor suited to many similar operations. Device memory holds parameters and working data; capacity is commonly measured in GB.

beats.zh: 计算单元要先拿到数字。带宽是每秒能搬多少数据，常用 GB/s；空间大与搬得快是两个指标。
beats.en: Compute units must receive the numbers. Bandwidth measures data moved per second, often GB/s; capacity and movement rate are different.

beats.zh: 输入[2,3]、[1,4]都与参数[5,4]逐项相乘相加，独立得到22、21。GPU并行做许多这类计算。
beats.en: Inputs [2,3] and [1,4] use shared parameters [5,4] to produce independent sums 22 and 21; GPUs parallelize many such operations.

Convert FP16, FP8 and 4-bit values into storage
points: 位数决定每个参数的原始大小

体积、速度与质量的取舍

title.zh: 15 多卡互联、集群与推理引擎
title.en: 15 GPU links, clusters and inference engines

title.zh: NVLink 与多卡连线：传的是哪些数据？
title.en: NVLink and multi-GPU links: what travels?

lead.zh: 当一份模型分在多张卡上，每张卡存一部分权重，并计算自己负责的部分。
lead.en: When a model spans GPUs, each stores and computes a portion.

key.zh: 引擎安排分片和通信；NVLink 连线本身不会把多张卡变成同一块显存。
key.en: An engine implements sharding and communication; links alone do not create one transparent memory pool.

steps.zh: 一次计算跨卡传中间结果

beats.zh: 同一模型的权重分在四张卡上。图中的每张卡只保存一份分片。
beats.en: One model is split over four cards, each holding a weight shard.

beats.zh: 设备之间需要数据通路。NVLink 是 GPU 互联技术之一；跨机器另有网络。
beats.en: Devices need paths for data. NVLink is one GPU interconnect; inter-node networking is another layer.

beats.zh: 一份请求经过各自负责的计算，中间状态沿连线传递，再得到结果。分片与通信要由引擎实现。
beats.en: A request passes through the assigned computation, exchanging intermediate states before output. Engines implement sharding and communication.

caption.zh: 示意流水式模型分片；真实张量、流水与专家并行的通信模式不同。
caption.en: Illustrative pipeline sharding; tensor, pipeline and expert parallelism communicate differently.

zh: 当一份模型分在多张卡上，每张卡存一部分权重，并计算自己负责的部分。层之间传中间结果，某些并行方式还要合并部分结果；训练也会交换梯度。NVLink 是 GPU 互联技术之一，帮助设备间交换数据；跨机器则还涉及机间网络。
把四张 24 GB 卡连起来，不代表任意程序立刻获得一块无差别的 96 GB 显存。推理引擎要实现分片与通信，具体设备和互联也要支持相应方式。图中先把权重块放到不同卡，再让一次请求经过这些卡，最后汇总；增加连线本身没有执行这些步骤。
en: When a model spans GPUs, each stores and computes a portion. Devices exchange intermediate values and sometimes combine partial results; training also exchanges gradients. NVLink is one GPU interconnect technology, while crossing machines involves the cluster network.

Four linked 24 GB cards do not automatically become one transparent 96 GB device for every program. The engine must shard and communicate using supported hardware. The diagram first places weight shards, then moves intermediate results and combines output: wires alone do not perform that work.

zh: 同一模型的权重分在四张卡上。图中的每张卡只保存一份分片。
设备之间需要数据通路。NVLink 是 GPU 互联技术之一；跨机器另有网络。
一份请求经过各自负责的计算，中间状态沿连线传递，再得到结果。分片与通信要由引擎实现。
物理通路已连好；集群放置服务，推理引擎才负责加载、生成与通信。
en: One model is split over four cards, each holding a weight shard.
Devices need paths for data. NVLink is one GPU interconnect; inter-node networking is another layer.
A request passes through the assigned computation, exchanging intermediate states before output. Engines implement sharding and communication.
With physical paths available, the cluster places services and the inference engine loads, generates and communicates.

transition.zh: 物理通路已连好；集群放置服务，推理引擎才负责加载、生成与通信。
transition.en: With physical paths available, the cluster places services and the inference engine loads, generates and communicates.

question.zh: 为什么多卡需要交换数据？
question.en: Why must GPUs exchange data?

answer.zh: 模型拆在多卡上，各卡计算自己负责的部分；后续计算需要前面产生的中间结果。
answer.en: Each card computes its portion of a split model; later computation needs intermediate values from earlier work.

question.zh: 四张 24 GB 卡就等于一张 96 GB 卡吗？
question.en: Are four 24 GB cards automatically one 96 GB GPU?

answer.zh: 不是。程序或引擎必须实现分片和通信；设备与拓扑也要支持相应并行方式。
answer.en: No. Software must implement sharding and communication on supported devices and topology.

question.zh: 这一页怎样接到下一步？
question.en: How does this connect to the next step?

answer.zh: 物理通路已连好；集群放置服务，推理引擎才负责加载、生成与通信。
answer.en: With physical paths available, the cluster places services and the inference engine loads, generates and communicates.

demonstration.zh: 先把四份权重放进不同卡，再显示连线，最后播放中间状态经过各卡。
demonstration.en: Place four shards, reveal the links, then move intermediate state through the cards.

pause.zh: 停在连线出现而请求未移动时：有线还不等于有分片执行。
pause.en: Pause after links appear: wires alone do not implement sharded execution.

opening.zh: 当一份模型分在多张卡上，每张卡存一部分权重，并计算自己负责的部分。
opening.en: When a model spans GPUs, each stores and computes a portion.

takeaway.zh: 引擎安排分片和通信；NVLink 连线本身不会把多张卡变成同一块显存。
takeaway.en: An engine implements sharding and communication; links alone do not create one transparent memory pool.

title.zh: NVLink 与多卡连线：传的是哪些数据？
title.en: NVLink and multi-GPU links: what travels?

title.zh: Kubernetes 放置服务，引擎运行模型
title.en: Kubernetes places services; engines execute models

lead.zh: 集群是一组联网的机器。Kubernetes（K8s）安排服务放哪里，推理引擎负责运行模型。
lead.en: A cluster is a group of networked machines. Kubernetes (K8s) places services; an inference engine runs the model.

key.zh: 集群是机器的组织；引擎是执行模型的程序。
key.en: A cluster organizes machines; an engine executes a model.

detail.zh: 安排实例在哪台节点运行

caption.zh: Prefill = 先处理输入；Decode = 逐步生成。KV 缓存保存注意力中的键/值数值，供后续复用。
caption.en: Prefill processes input; decode generates step by step. A KV cache retains attention key/value states for reuse.

beats.zh: 集群是联网管理的一组机器；其中一台叫节点。Kubernetes，简称 K8s，是安排程序在哪台机器运行的软件。
beats.en: A cluster is a managed group of networked machines; each machine is a node. Kubernetes, or K8s, places programs on those machines.

beats.zh: 这里要一块 GPU，第一台有空位，就把一个模型服务放过去。实例就是正在运行的一份服务；Pod 是 K8s 放置它的运行单元。
beats.en: This service needs one GPU and node one has room. An instance is one running copy of a service; a pod is its Kubernetes execution unit.

beats.zh: 推理引擎是在节点上加载参数、执行模型计算的程序，例如 vLLM。K8s 管放哪里，引擎管怎样算。
beats.en: An inference engine loads parameters and runs model computation on a node, for example vLLM. K8s places the service; the engine executes it.

beats.zh: Prefill处理A/B/C生成D并保存旧记录。Decode读取A/B/C缓存，计算并追加D的记录，再生成E；没有丢掉前文。
beats.en: Prefill processes A/B/C, caches their states and generates D. Decode reads those states, computes and appends D's states, then generates E.

zh: 集群是联网管理的一组机器；其中一台叫节点。Kubernetes，简称 K8s，是安排程序在哪台机器运行的软件。
这里要一块 GPU，第一台有空位，就把一个模型服务放过去。实例就是正在运行的一份服务；Pod 是 K8s 放置它的运行单元。
推理引擎是在节点上加载参数、执行模型计算的程序，例如 vLLM。K8s 管放哪里，引擎管怎样算。
Prefill处理A/B/C生成D并保存旧记录。Decode读取A/B/C缓存，计算并追加D的记录，再生成E；没有丢掉前文。
服务开始运行后，用一条请求的时间线看等待发生在哪里。
en: A cluster is a managed group of networked machines; each machine is a node. Kubernetes, or K8s, places programs on those machines.
This service needs one GPU and node one has room. An instance is one running copy of a service; a pod is its Kubernetes execution unit.
An inference engine loads parameters and runs model computation on a node, for example vLLM. K8s places the service; the engine executes it.
Prefill processes A/B/C, caches their states and generates D. Decode reads those states, computes and appends D's states, then generates E.
Once serving runs, trace one request's timeline to locate waiting.

zh: 上面的 Kubernetes 管程序在哪里运行，是控制和放置这一层。中间的请求线经过运行中的模型实例，再由推理引擎组织实际计算。把控制安排与请求路径分开，就不会把编排程序当成生成模型的程序。
对于自回归文本模型，引擎先处理输入，这一段叫 prefill；接着逐 Token 生成，叫 decode。生成时，部分前文的注意力计算状态留在 KV cache 里，后面继续使用。引擎还会安排多个用户的请求如何一起计算。给两个名词后就回到图：它们都是模型执行里面的具体工作。
多台这样的节点联网管理，就形成集群。一个节点可能有多块 GPU，设备之间和机器之间还需要互连与网络。
en: Kubernetes handles placement and reconciliation above the request path. The running model instance receives requests and its engine executes the model. Keep placement separate from generation.

Autoregressive engines process input during prefill and generate tokens during decode. The KV cache reuses attention state. Engines also organize concurrent work. These terms describe execution within the diagram.
Several connected nodes form a cluster. Nodes may contain multiple GPUs and communicate through device interconnects and networks.

transition.zh: 服务开始运行后，用一条请求的时间线看等待发生在哪里。
transition.en: Once serving runs, trace one request's timeline to locate waiting.

opening.zh: 现在把能存会算的设备组织成服务。先找位置：一台机器叫节点，联网管理起来叫集群，Kubernetes安排一份服务放在哪里。然后才看服务里运行的推理引擎。不要把放置服务和生成每个Token混在一起。输入A/B/C算过的注意力记录可以保留：这些位置不会回看后来新生成的D，所以追加D不必重算旧记录。但生成E仍要读取A/B/C的缓存并计算D的新记录，缓存省的是重复计算，不是把前文丢掉。
opening.en: Organize devices into services. A node is a machine in a managed cluster; Kubernetes places a service, while its inference engine performs model execution. Placement is not repeated per token. Earlier positions do not attend to later generated tokens, so their attention states can be retained. Generating E still reads cached A/B/C states and computes the new D state. A cache avoids recomputation without discarding context.

question.zh: 为什么KV缓存能复用，旧内容不会变吗？
question.en: Why can old KV states be reused?

answer.zh: 这里讲因果生成模型：旧位置只依赖它及之前的内容，不看之后新生成的Token，所以其键和值记录可复用。
answer.en: In this causal generation model, an earlier position depends only on itself and preceding content, not later generated tokens.

question.zh: 生成E时到底算什么、读什么？
question.en: What is read and computed to generate E?

answer.zh: 引擎读A/B/C已有记录，处理新输入D并追加D记录，结合这些信息预测E；D不是上一步已经处理过的输入。
answer.en: Read cached A/B/C, process D and append its states, then predict E. D was produced by the previous step rather than already processed as its input.

question.zh: 这一页怎样接到下一步？
question.en: How does this connect to the next step?

answer.zh: 服务开始运行后，用一条请求的时间线看等待发生在哪里。
answer.en: Once serving runs, trace one request's timeline to locate waiting.

demonstration.zh: 先放置服务，再在引擎内按时间展开Prefill与Decode；指A/B/C同色复用、D新增，最后指出E是新输出。
demonstration.en: Place the service, then unfold prefill and decode; distinguish reused A/B/C, newly stored D and output E.

pause.zh: 先问生成E是否还需要A/B/C，确认需要后才显示“读缓存+新D”。
pause.en: Ask whether E still needs A/B/C before showing cached states plus D.

takeaway.en: A cluster organizes machines; an engine executes a model.

title: NVLink 与多卡连线：传的是哪些数据？
NVLink and multi-GPU links: what travels?
points: 卡之间交叉连接的拓扑图
paragraphs: 当一份模型分在多张卡上，每张卡存一部分权重，并计算自己负责的部分。层之间传中间结果，某些并行方式还要合并部分结果；训练也会交换梯度。NVLink 是 GPU 互联技术之一，帮助设备间交换数据；跨机器则还涉及机间网络。

When a model spans GPUs, each stores and computes a portion. Devices exchange intermediate values and sometimes combine partial results; training also exchanges gradients. NVLink is one GPU interconnect technology, while crossing machines involves the cluster network.
把四张 24 GB 卡连起来，不代表任意程序立刻获得一块无差别的 96 GB 显存。推理引擎要实现分片与通信，具体设备和互联也要支持相应方式。图中先把权重块放到不同卡，再让一次请求经过这些卡，最后汇总；增加连线本身没有执行这些步骤。

Four linked 24 GB cards do not automatically become one transparent 96 GB device for every program. The engine must shard and communicate using supported hardware. The diagram first places weight shards, then moves intermediate results and combines output: wires alone do not perform that work.

steps.zh: 一次计算跨卡传中间结果

beats.zh: 同一模型的权重分在四张卡上。图中的每张卡只保存一份分片。
beats.en: One model is split over four cards, each holding a weight shard.

beats.zh: 设备之间需要数据通路。NVLink 是 GPU 互联技术之一；跨机器另有网络。
beats.en: Devices need paths for data. NVLink is one GPU interconnect; inter-node networking is another layer.

beats.zh: 一份请求经过各自负责的计算，中间状态沿连线传递，再得到结果。分片与通信要由引擎实现。
beats.en: A request passes through the assigned computation, exchanging intermediate states before output. Engines implement sharding and communication.

caption.zh: 示意流水式模型分片；真实张量、流水与专家并行的通信模式不同。
caption.en: Illustrative pipeline sharding; tensor, pipeline and expert parallelism communicate differently.

title: Kubernetes 放置服务，引擎运行模型
Kubernetes places services; engines execute models
paragraphs: 现在把能存会算的设备组织成服务。先找位置：一台机器叫节点，联网管理起来叫集群，Kubernetes安排一份服务放在哪里。然后才看服务里运行的推理引擎。不要把放置服务和生成每个Token混在一起。输入A/B/C算过的注意力记录可以保留：这些位置不会回看后来新生成的D，所以追加D不必重算旧记录。但生成E仍要读取A/B/C的缓存并计算D的新记录，缓存省的是重复计算，不是把前文丢掉。

Organize devices into services. A node is a machine in a managed cluster; Kubernetes places a service, while its inference engine performs model execution. Placement is not repeated per token. Earlier positions do not attend to later generated tokens, so their attention states can be retained. Generating E still reads cached A/B/C states and computes the new D state. A cache avoids recomputation without discarding context.
集群是机器的组织；引擎是执行模型的程序。
A cluster organizes machines; an engine executes a model.

detail.zh: 安排实例在哪台节点运行

caption.zh: Prefill = 先处理输入；Decode = 逐步生成。KV 缓存保存注意力中的键/值数值，供后续复用。
caption.en: Prefill processes input; decode generates step by step. A KV cache retains attention key/value states for reuse.

beats.zh: 集群是联网管理的一组机器；其中一台叫节点。Kubernetes，简称 K8s，是安排程序在哪台机器运行的软件。
beats.en: A cluster is a managed group of networked machines; each machine is a node. Kubernetes, or K8s, places programs on those machines.

beats.zh: 这里要一块 GPU，第一台有空位，就把一个模型服务放过去。实例就是正在运行的一份服务；Pod 是 K8s 放置它的运行单元。
beats.en: This service needs one GPU and node one has room. An instance is one running copy of a service; a pod is its Kubernetes execution unit.

beats.zh: 推理引擎是在节点上加载参数、执行模型计算的程序，例如 vLLM。K8s 管放哪里，引擎管怎样算。
beats.en: An inference engine loads parameters and runs model computation on a node, for example vLLM. K8s places the service; the engine executes it.

beats.zh: Prefill处理A/B/C生成D并保存旧记录。Decode读取A/B/C缓存，计算并追加D的记录，再生成E；没有丢掉前文。
beats.en: Prefill processes A/B/C, caches their states and generates D. Decode reads those states, computes and appends D's states, then generates E.

concepts: K8s放服务；引擎读取缓存、计算新位置并生成。
Kubernetes places services; engines read caches and compute new positions.

references.title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models

title.zh: 一次回答的时间，画在同一条线上
title.en: Put one response on a timeline

lead.zh: 延迟是一次请求花的时间；分别看多久开始有字、多久全部结束。
lead.en: Latency is time for a request: distinguish the first visible output from full completion.

key.zh: 端到端延迟 = 首 Token 等待 + 首个之后的生成时间。
key.en: End-to-end latency = first-token wait + generation after the first token.

caption.zh: 教学时间线；点只表示到达过程，不逐个对应全部 Token。
caption.en: Illustrative timeline; dots depict arrivals rather than every token.

beats.zh: 延迟就是一次请求要等多久。从点击发送开始计时，直到回答全部结束，是端到端延迟。
beats.en: Latency measures how long a request takes. End-to-end latency runs from sending it to the completed response.

beats.zh: 0.8 秒时第一个 Token 到达。首 Token 等待时间简称 TTFT，包括网络、排队和处理输入等时间。
beats.en: The first token arrives at 0.8 seconds. Time to first token, TTFT, includes network, queueing and input processing.

beats.zh: 第一个之后还生成 2 秒，文字逐步到达。这段是后续生成时间，和首个之前的等待分开看。
beats.en: More tokens arrive over the next two seconds. This is subsequent generation time, separate from the wait for the first token.

beats.zh: 在 2.8 秒回答结束。首个等待 0.8 秒 + 后续生成 2 秒 = 全程 2.8 秒。
beats.en: The response ends at 2.8 seconds: 0.8 seconds to the first token plus two seconds of further generation.

第一个之后还生成 2 秒，文字逐步到达。这段是后续生成时间，和首个之前的等待分开看。
在 2.8 秒回答结束。首个等待 0.8 秒 + 后续生成 2 秒 = 全程 2.8 秒。
一位用户的等待与所有请求的总产出不同；再比较批处理怎样影响吞吐。
en: Latency measures how long a request takes. End-to-end latency runs from sending it to the completed response.
The first token arrives at 0.8 seconds. Time to first token, TTFT, includes network, queueing and input processing.
More tokens arrive over the next two seconds. This is subsequent generation time, separate from the wait for the first token.
The response ends at 2.8 seconds: 0.8 seconds to the first token plus two seconds of further generation.
One user's wait differs from aggregate production. Compare how batching affects throughput.

zh: 先只显示时间轴。第二步出现0.8秒等待条，首Token到达。第三步显示后面的生成。最后整个回答在2.8秒结束。首Token等待常称TTFT，端到端则是从发送到结束。
让观众看同一条时间线，避免只背定义。首个之前可以包含网络、排队和输入处理。开始流式输出后，用户主要感受到后面生成得快不快。这里的两段颜色有明确时间边界。
en: Reveal the axis, the first-token wait, subsequent generation and the final total. TTFT ends at the first received token; end-to-end timing ends when the response finishes.
The first period may include network, queueing and input processing. After output starts, stream speed becomes visible. The colours show distinct timing boundaries.

transition.zh: 一位用户的等待与所有请求的总产出不同；再比较批处理怎样影响吞吐。
transition.en: One user's wait differs from aggregate production. Compare how batching affects throughput.

opening.zh: 现在换成一个用户的视角：我点发送，要等多久？先等到首个Token，再等后续内容到齐，这是两种不同体验。0.8秒不是纯粹“模型想了多久”，还可能包含网络、排队和输入处理。图中后续生成又花2秒，所以全程2.8秒。同一服务可能很快开始出字，却还要很久才能写完；先把计时边界指出来，再讨论快慢。
opening.en: Take one user's perspective: how long after sending? Time to first token and time to finish capture different experiences. The initial 0.8 seconds can include network, queueing and input processing, not just model computation. Two further seconds give 2.8 seconds total. Fast first output and fast completion are different; identify timing boundaries before comparing speed.

question.zh: 为什么首字快，不等于整段快？
question.en: Why does fast first output not imply fast completion?

answer.zh: 首字之前和后续生成是两段时间；后面输出多或生成慢，全程仍可能很长。
answer.en: The initial wait and later generation are separate; long output or slow continuation can extend total time.

question.zh: 2.8秒怎么来，计时从哪里开始？
question.en: Where does 2.8 seconds come from?

answer.zh: 从应用发出请求到完成，先等0.8秒首Token，再生成2秒，相加2.8秒。
answer.en: The interval from sending to completion contains 0.8 seconds to the first token plus two seconds of continuation.

question.zh: 这一页怎样接到下一步？
question.en: How does this connect to the next step?

answer.zh: 一位用户的等待与所有请求的总产出不同；再比较批处理怎样影响吞吐。
answer.en: One user's wait differs from aggregate production. Compare how batching affects throughput.

demonstration.zh: 按发送、首个、后续、结束四步计时；每次只读对应的区间。
demonstration.en: Trace sending, first token, continuation and completion on one timeline.

pause.zh: 先让学生指TTFT的终点，再指整段回答的终点。
pause.en: Identify the end of TTFT and the end of the whole response.

takeaway.zh: 端到端延迟 = 首 Token 等待 + 首个之后的生成时间。
takeaway.en: End-to-end latency = first-token wait + generation after the first token.

instruction.en: Keep the worked example and mechanism.

title.zh: 一次回答的时间，画在同一条线上
title.en: Put one response on a timeline

title.zh: 同样的请求，怎样组织批次？

lead.zh: 吞吐量是系统每秒完成的总工作量；批处理是把多个请求放在一起计算。
lead.en: Throughput is total work completed per second; batching groups requests for computation.

key.zh: 总吞吐 = 观察窗口内的总输出 Token ÷ 时间。
key.en: Aggregate throughput = total output tokens divided by elapsed time.

caption.zh: 简化算例：只看逐步生成，每槽位每轮 1 Token；忽略输入处理与调度开销，不代表真实每轮速度。
caption.en: Simplified decode-only example: one token per slot per round, ignoring input processing and scheduling cost; not measured speed.

beats.zh: 吞吐是系统每秒一共处理多少，这里数输出 Token。四人分别要 2、4、1、3 个，共 10 个；两个槽位表示每轮最多推进两人。
beats.en: Throughput measures total work per second, here output tokens. Four requests need 2, 4, 1, 3 tokens, ten in total. Two slots advance at most two requests per round.

beats.zh: 每格 A1 表示 A 的第一个 Token。第 3 轮 A 已结束：固定批次空等 B，连续批处理把 C 放进空位；下方一轮一轮比较。
beats.en: Cell A1 is A's first token. By round three A has finished: fixed batches wait for B, while continuous batching puts C in the free slot. Compare round by round.

beats.zh: 同样10个Token，固定批次7轮、连续批处理6轮。B两种都第4轮完成：总吞吐提高不等于每个人都更快。
beats.en: Ten tokens finish in seven versus six rounds, but B finishes at round four under both: aggregate throughput and individual latency differ.

zh: 吞吐是系统每秒一共处理多少，这里数输出 Token。四人分别要 2、4、1、3 个，共 10 个；两个槽位表示每轮最多推进两人。
每格 A1 表示 A 的第一个 Token。第 3 轮 A 已结束：固定批次空等 B，连续批处理把 C 放进空位；下方一轮一轮比较。
同样10个Token，固定批次7轮、连续批处理6轮。B两种都第4轮完成：总吞吐提高不等于每个人都更快。
把单次计算放回持续系统：电力、散热、网络、引擎一起支撑长期产出。
en: Throughput measures total work per second, here output tokens. Four requests need 2, 4, 1, 3 tokens, ten in total. Two slots advance at most two requests per round.
Cell A1 is A's first token. By round three A has finished: fixed batches wait for B, while continuous batching puts C in the free slot. Compare round by round.
Ten tokens finish in seven versus six rounds, but B finishes at round four under both: aggregate throughput and individual latency differ.
Place individual computation inside a sustained system of power, cooling, networking and engines.

zh: 先确认两行使用相同工作量：A、B、C、D 共十个输出 Token，两个计算槽位。按“计算一轮”一起推进。第三轮时，上面的 A 已完成，却必须等 B；下面已把 C 放进空位。两个策略分别在第七、第六轮完成。颜色保持请求身份，字母后的数字是该请求的第几个输出 Token。
这只是说明完成一个请求后如何补入新请求。真实推理还要处理 Prefill、内存和每轮不同的计算时间，所以不能拿七比六当实测加速比。统计总吞吐时，若十秒生成二十个各一百 Token 的回答，就是两千除以十，得到每秒二百 Token；这也不等于其中一个人的流式速度。
en: Both schedules process the same ten output tokens in two slots. Advance them together with Compute one round. At round three, fixed batching leaves A's slot empty while B finishes; continuous batching has already admitted C. They finish in seven and six rounds. Colors identify requests; the digit is that request's output-token index.

Real serving also includes prefill, memory and variable iteration times; this is not a measured speedup. If twenty responses of one hundred tokens finish in ten seconds, aggregate throughput is two hundred output tokens per second. This is different from one person's stream speed.

transition.zh: 把单次计算放回持续系统：电力、散热、网络、引擎一起支撑长期产出。
transition.en: Place individual computation inside a sustained system of power, cooling, networking and engines.

opening.zh: 上一页只数一人的输出，现在把四名用户合起来。A要2个、B要4个、C要1个、D要3个，总工作量相同。两个槽位让每轮最多推进两人，每人每轮一个Token。关键看第3轮：A已经结束，固定批次还等B，连续批处理让C补入。后者更早完成总工作，但B在两种方式下仍都是第4轮结束。系统吞吐和每个人的延迟不是同一个数字。
opening.en: Move from one user's output to four requests totaling ten tokens. Two slots each advance one token per active request per round. By round three A has finished: a fixed batch waits for B, while continuous batching inserts C. Total work finishes earlier, yet B still finishes in round four under both policies. Aggregate throughput and individual latency are different measures.

question.zh: 为什么补空位能提高总吞吐？
question.en: Why does refilling improve throughput?

answer.zh: 相同工作和资源下减少空等，更多轮次用足槽位，总任务完成得更早。
answer.en: It reduces idle slots under the same work and resources, completing the workload earlier.

question.zh: 第3轮究竟不同在哪？
question.en: What differs in round three?

answer.zh: 固定批次只有B3在算，另一槽为空；连续批处理同时算C1与B3，累计输出从5变6。
answer.en: Fixed batching computes B3 with an idle slot; continuous batching computes C1 and B3, giving six cumulative tokens instead of five.

question.zh: 这一页怎样接到下一步？
question.en: How does this connect to the next step?

answer.zh: 把单次计算放回持续系统：电力、散热、网络、引擎一起支撑长期产出。
answer.en: Place individual computation inside a sustained system of power, cooling, networking and engines.

demonstration.zh: 单轮推进到第3轮就停，核对两个槽和5/6累计值；解释后再播到完成。
demonstration.en: Advance manually to round three, compare slots and five/six tokens, then finish the schedule.

pause.zh: 把空槽指给学生，先预测谁能补进来，再推进。
pause.en: Point to the idle slot and predict who can fill it before advancing.

takeaway.zh: 总吞吐 = 观察窗口内的总输出 Token ÷ 时间。
takeaway.en: Aggregate throughput = total output tokens divided by elapsed time.

beats.zh: 每格 A1 表示 A 的第一个 Token。第 3 轮 A 已结束：固定批次空等 B，连续批处理把 C 放进空位；下方一轮一轮比较。
beats.en: Cell A1 is A's first token. By round three A has finished: fixed batches wait for B, while continuous batching puts C in the free slot. Compare round by round.

beats.zh: 同样10个Token，固定批次7轮、连续批处理6轮。B两种都第4轮完成：总吞吐提高不等于每个人都更快。
beats.en: Ten tokens finish in seven versus six rounds, but B finishes at round four under both: aggregate throughput and individual latency differ.

concepts: 连续批处理减少空等；总吞吐与个人等待分开统计。

title.zh: 18 选模型：生态、任务与 MoE
title.en: 18 Model choice: ecosystem, task and MoE

title.zh: 生态、装得下与业务匹配
title.en: Ecosystem, feasible size and task fit

lead.zh: 生态指让模型被实际使用的一整套支持：分词器、对话模板、推理引擎、客户端、工具调用格式、示例和维护。
lead.en: An ecosystem includes tokenizers, chat templates, inference engines, clients, tool-call formats, examples and maintenance.

key.zh: 先确定任务，再检查工具链、容量、并发、稳定性和实际完成结果。
key.en: Start from the task, then compare toolchains, capacity, concurrency, consistency and outcomes.

beats.zh: 先定义三个任务及完成条件，不先决定哪个品牌胜出。
beats.en: Define tasks and completion conditions before comparing brands.

beats.zh: 保持任务条件一致，把模型、工具与执行看作一个候选系统。
beats.en: Keep task conditions comparable and treat model, tools and execution as one candidate.

beats.zh: 本例三个任务中完成两个，完成率为 2/3；仍保留未完成的那一项和时间、用量。
beats.en: The teaching example completes two of three tasks. Keep the failed item, time and usage alongside 2/3 completion.

caption.zh: 合成评分样例，不是任何实际产品的评测结果。
caption.en: Synthetic scoring example, not measured product performance.

zh: 生态指让模型被实际使用的一整套支持：分词器、对话模板、推理引擎、客户端、工具调用格式、示例和维护。相同权重如果缺少引擎支持，可能很难在现有设备上高效运行；如果工具格式没有接好，模型提出的动作也不能顺利执行。
比较两个方案时，可以先完成一个最小但完整的任务：读一份文件、回答一个能核对的问题、再调用一个真实工具。这样测试的是模型与工具链的结合，不只是网页聊天是否能打开。生态让接入和使用更顺，不等于保证每个任务的答案质量。
先计算权重、缓存和工作空间，再考虑实际上下文长度与同时请求数。装下权重只是起点：长文章和多并发会增加 KV 缓存，较慢设备可能让用户长时间等待。API 调用把模型运行交给服务方，但仍要比较服务延迟、配额和使用成本。
“选择能跑的最大模型”是候选筛选思路，不是最终答案。若较小模型已经能稳定完成字段提取，较大模型却让响应显著变慢，就应比较完成质量与资源代价。设备条件相同、任务输入相同，比较结果才有解释力。
选一组真实输入并写清什么算完成。例如纪要任务可以核对事项、负责人、日期是否与原文一致；代码任务可以运行测试；图像任务要看对象、构图与文字是否满足要求。DeepSeek、Qwen 等模型家族可以进候选，但名字本身不是评分。
自动评测适合能精确检查的部分；开放写作或视觉质量需要明确的人类判断标准。Benchmark 提供其他任务上的参考，自己的任务集解释本地适配程度。记录具体版本、提示词、工具、输入长度和尝试次数，避免把不同条件的分数拼成一个排名。
一个可复用的比较表至少保留：任务是否完成、关键字段或测试结果、首个输出等待、总完成时间、用量和失败类型。课程中这些字段是测量方法，没有填入虚构的产品胜负数据。
en: An ecosystem includes tokenizers, chat templates, inference engines, clients, tool-call formats, examples and maintenance. Weights without suitable engine support may be difficult to run efficiently; unsupported tool formats prevent proposed actions from being executed correctly.

Compare a complete small task: read a document, answer a checkable question and use one actual tool. That tests the model-toolchain combination rather than whether a chat page opens. Ecosystem fit improves usability but does not guarantee answer quality.

Estimate weights, caches and working space for the intended context and concurrency. Fitting weights is only the start: long inputs and simultaneous requests grow cache use, and slow execution increases waiting. An API moves operation to a provider, while service latency, quotas and usage cost still matter.

The largest runnable model is a candidate, not automatically the winner. If a smaller model reliably extracts the required fields while a larger one is much slower, compare quality against resources. Keep device and task conditions comparable.

Use representative inputs and define completion. Meeting notes can be checked for correct tasks, owners and dates; code can run tests; images need subject, composition and text criteria. Families such as DeepSeek and Qwen are candidates, not scores.

Automatic grading suits precisely checkable outcomes; open writing and visual quality need explicit human criteria. Public benchmarks provide context, while local tasks test your fit. Record checkpoint, prompt, tools, input length and attempts rather than combining incomparable scores.

A useful comparison records task completion, fields or tests, first-output wait, total time, usage and failure categories. These are measurement fields; the course does not fill them with invented product results.

zh: 先定义三个任务及完成条件，不先决定哪个品牌胜出。
保持任务条件一致，把模型、工具与执行看作一个候选系统。
本例三个任务中完成两个，完成率为 2/3；仍保留未完成的那一项和时间、用量。
选型会遇到总参数与激活参数两个数字；打开 MoE 路由看它们为什么不同。
en: Define tasks and completion conditions before comparing brands.
Keep task conditions comparable and treat model, tools and execution as one candidate.
The teaching example completes two of three tasks. Keep the failed item, time and usage alongside 2/3 completion.
Selection involves total and active parameter counts. Open MoE routing to explain the distinction.

question.en: Why might the largest model be unsuitable?

answer.zh: 权重能装下还不够；上下文、并发、延迟、工具链和稳定完成任务都需要比较。
answer.en: Fitting weights is only a start. Compare context, concurrency, latency, toolchain support and consistent task completion.

question.zh: 怎样做一个公平的本地比较？
question.en: How can we compare locally?

answer.zh: 固定输入、工具、评分和尝试次数，记录是否完成、关键错误、时间与用量。
answer.en: Fix inputs, tools, scoring and attempts; record completion, errors, time and usage.

instruction.en: Keep the worked example and mechanism.

title.zh: 生态、装得下与业务匹配
title.en: Ecosystem, feasible size and task fit

title.zh: MoE：每个 Token 只走部分专家
title.en: MoE: a token uses selected expert modules

lead.zh: MoE 是 Mixture of Experts，混合专家。
lead.en: MoE means Mixture of Experts.

key.zh: 35B 总参数、A3B 激活：少算一部分，不代表只需存 3B 权重。
key.en: 35B total, A3B active: selective computation does not reduce storage to 3B weights.

steps.zh: 所有专家属于同一个模型
路由器为本次输入评分
只计算选中的两个专家
下一 Token 可以换路线
steps.en: A new token can take another route

beats.zh: 图中四个专家都是参数模块，先看完整存储范围；它们不是四个 Agent。
beats.en: The four experts are parameter modules within one model, not four agents.

beats.zh: 当前输入得到四个路由分数；本例取最高的两个，并重新归一化组合权重。
beats.en: Score all four routes, select the top two, then normalize their mixing weights in this example.

beats.zh: 本轮只执行选中的专家，再把结果加权组合；未选专家仍保留在模型里。
beats.en: Run the selected experts and mix their results; unselected experts remain stored.

beats.zh: 切换 Token A／B，观察被选中的专家和组合结果怎样变化。真实 MoE 通常还有共享计算。
beats.en: Switch tokens A/B to see selected experts and mixed output change. Real MoE also includes shared computation.

caption.zh: 4 专家选 2 的教学算例，不是 Qwen 实际路由配置；专家输出也是示意数值。
caption.en: Toy top-2-of-4 routing, not Qwen's actual configuration; expert outputs are illustrative.

zh: MoE 是 Mixture of Experts，混合专家。这里的专家是模型内部的计算模块，不是几个独立聊天机器人。路由器根据当前 Token 的表示选择一部分专家计算，再组合结果；不同 Token 可以选择不同路径。模型通常还有注意力等共享计算，不能把全部计算都理解为只选两个专家。
总参数数的是模型保存的全部可调整数；激活参数数的是某次 Token 计算使用的那部分。因此“大体积、较少激活”可以同时成立。未被这一步选中的专家并没有从模型中消失，下一个 Token 还可能用到它们。
以官方 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 为例，名称中的 35B 表示约 350 亿总参数，A3B 表示约 30 亿激活参数。A 是 activated 的提示，不是把 35B 模型直接压缩成 3B 文件。路由节省部分计算，存储仍要考虑完整权重或实际采用的分片、卸载方案。
用统一 16 位做粗算：35×10⁹×2 Byte≈70 GB 原始权重；不能拿 3B×2=6 GB 当作整个模型的显存需求。真实占用还取决于发布精度、额外模块、缓存和引擎实现。这正是“参数活跃得少”与“设备装得下”需要分别判断的原因。
en: MoE means Mixture of Experts. Experts are internal computation modules, not independent chatbots. A router selects some modules for a token representation and combines their results; another token may take another route. Shared attention and other computation still exist.

Total parameters count the model's adjustable values; active parameters describe the subset used for a token. A large model with sparse activation is therefore possible. Unselected experts remain part of the model and may be needed for later tokens.

In the official Qwen3.6-35B-A3B example, 35B denotes about 35 billion total parameters and A3B about 3 billion active parameters. A indicates activation, not a 3B-sized checkpoint. Routing saves some computation while storage still depends on full weights or an actual sharding/offloading scheme.

At a uniform 16 bits, raw weights are roughly 35×10⁹×2≈70 GB. Using 3B×2=6 GB as the whole model's requirement is incorrect. Released precision, extra modules, caches and engine implementation also matter.

zh: 图中四个专家都是参数模块，先看完整存储范围；它们不是四个 Agent。
当前输入得到四个路由分数；本例取最高的两个，并重新归一化组合权重。
本轮只执行选中的专家，再把结果加权组合；未选专家仍保留在模型里。
切换 Token A／B，观察被选中的专家和组合结果怎样变化。真实 MoE 通常还有共享计算。
规模读懂以后，还要确认输入输出模态；会看图与会画图不是同一规格。
en: The four experts are parameter modules within one model, not four agents.
Score all four routes, select the top two, then normalize their mixing weights in this example.
Run the selected experts and mix their results; unselected experts remain stored.
Switch tokens A/B to see selected experts and mixed output change. Real MoE also includes shared computation.

question.zh: MoE 专家是几个 Agent 吗？
question.en: Are MoE experts separate agents?

answer.zh: 不是。专家是同一模型内的参数模块；Agent 是组织模型、工具与动作的系统。
answer.en: No. Experts are parameter modules inside one model; an agent organizes model use, tools and actions.

question.zh: A 的组合结果怎样算？
question.en: How is A's mixed output computed?

answer.zh: 选分数 0.5 和 0.25，归一化成 2/3 和 1/3；乘专家输出 2、4，得到 8/3。
answer.en: Select scores 0.5 and 0.25, normalize to 2/3 and 1/3, then mix outputs 2 and 4 to obtain 8/3.

answer.en: After interpreting scale, check modalities: understanding an image differs from generating one.

demonstration.en: Show all stored experts, route A, then switch to B and compare selected experts and output.

title.zh: MoE：每个 Token 只走部分专家

title.zh: 图像、文字与视频，先看输入输出模态
title.en: Images, text and video: identify the modalities first

lead.zh: 看懂图片并输出文字，叫图像理解；从文字生成图片，叫图像生成；生成视频又是另一种输出任务。
lead.en: Image understanding produces an interpretation of an image; image generation creates one; video generation is another output task.

key.zh: 识图输出文字、生成图像、生成视频，是三种不同的输入输出任务。
key.en: Image understanding, image generation and video generation are different input-output tasks.

beats.zh: 输入：图片 + 问题；输出：文字描述
beats.en: Input: image + question; Output: description

beats.zh: 输入：文字或图片；输出：图像
beats.en: Input: text or image; Output: image

beats.zh: 输入：文字／参考素材；输出：视频序列
beats.en: Input: text / reference; Output: video

title: 生态好，具体好在哪里？
What makes an ecosystem useful?
points: 生态旁括号英文（反光待核对）
paragraphs: 生态指让模型被实际使用的一整套支持：分词器、对话模板、推理引擎、客户端、工具调用格式、示例和维护。相同权重如果缺少引擎支持，可能很难在现有设备上高效运行；如果工具格式没有接好，模型提出的动作也不能顺利执行。

An ecosystem includes tokenizers, chat templates, inference engines, clients, tool-call formats, examples and maintenance. Weights without suitable engine support may be difficult to run efficiently; unsupported tool formats prevent proposed actions from being executed correctly.
比较两个方案时，可以先完成一个最小但完整的任务：读一份文件、回答一个能核对的问题、再调用一个真实工具。这样测试的是模型与工具链的结合，不只是网页聊天是否能打开。生态让接入和使用更顺，不等于保证每个任务的答案质量。

Compare a complete small task: read a document, answer a checkable question and use one actual tool. That tests the model-toolchain combination rather than whether a chat page opens. Ecosystem fit improves usability but does not guarantee answer quality.

title: 选能装下的模型，再比较任务表现
Fit the deployment, then compare the task
paragraphs: 先计算权重、缓存和工作空间，再考虑实际上下文长度与同时请求数。装下权重只是起点：长文章和多并发会增加 KV 缓存，较慢设备可能让用户长时间等待。API 调用把模型运行交给服务方，但仍要比较服务延迟、配额和使用成本。

Estimate weights, caches and working space for the intended context and concurrency. Fitting weights is only the start: long inputs and simultaneous requests grow cache use, and slow execution increases waiting. An API moves operation to a provider, while service latency, quotas and usage cost still matter.
“选择能跑的最大模型”是候选筛选思路，不是最终答案。若较小模型已经能稳定完成字段提取，较大模型却让响应显著变慢，就应比较完成质量与资源代价。设备条件相同、任务输入相同，比较结果才有解释力。

The largest runnable model is a candidate, not automatically the winner. If a smaller model reliably extracts the required fields while a larger one is much slower, compare quality against resources. Keep device and task conditions comparable.

title: 业务匹配：先有自己的任务，再看榜单
Task fit: start with your work, then consult benchmarks
points: DeepSeek 与 Qwen 作为候选
paragraphs: 选一组真实输入并写清什么算完成。例如纪要任务可以核对事项、负责人、日期是否与原文一致；代码任务可以运行测试；图像任务要看对象、构图与文字是否满足要求。DeepSeek、Qwen 等模型家族可以进候选，但名字本身不是评分。

Use representative inputs and define completion. Meeting notes can be checked for correct tasks, owners and dates; code can run tests; images need subject, composition and text criteria. Families such as DeepSeek and Qwen are candidates, not scores.
自动评测适合能精确检查的部分；开放写作或视觉质量需要明确的人类判断标准。Benchmark 提供其他任务上的参考，自己的任务集解释本地适配程度。记录具体版本、提示词、工具、输入长度和尝试次数，避免把不同条件的分数拼成一个排名。

Automatic grading suits precisely checkable outcomes; open writing and visual quality need explicit human criteria. Public benchmarks provide context, while local tasks test your fit. Record checkpoint, prompt, tools, input length and attempts rather than combining incomparable scores.
一个可复用的比较表至少保留：任务是否完成、关键字段或测试结果、首个输出等待、总完成时间、用量和失败类型。课程中这些字段是测量方法，没有填入虚构的产品胜负数据。

A useful comparison records task completion, fields or tests, first-output wait, total time, usage and failure categories. These are measurement fields; the course does not fill them with invented product results.

beats.en: Define tasks and completion conditions before comparing brands.

caption.zh: 合成评分样例，不是任何实际产品的评测结果。

title: MoE：每个 Token 只走部分专家
MoE: a token uses selected expert modules
points: Mixture of Experts（英文拼写规范化）
paragraphs: MoE 是 Mixture of Experts，混合专家。这里的专家是模型内部的计算模块，不是几个独立聊天机器人。路由器根据当前 Token 的表示选择一部分专家计算，再组合结果；不同 Token 可以选择不同路径。模型通常还有注意力等共享计算，不能把全部计算都理解为只选两个专家。

MoE means Mixture of Experts. Experts are internal computation modules, not independent chatbots. A router selects some modules for a token representation and combines their results; another token may take another route. Shared attention and other computation still exist.
总参数数的是模型保存的全部可调整数；激活参数数的是某次 Token 计算使用的那部分。因此“大体积、较少激活”可以同时成立。未被这一步选中的专家并没有从模型中消失，下一个 Token 还可能用到它们。

Total parameters count the model's adjustable values; active parameters describe the subset used for a token. A large model with sparse activation is therefore possible. Unselected experts remain part of the model and may be needed for later tokens.

title: 读懂 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B
Read Qwen3.6-35B-A3B correctly
paragraphs: 以官方 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 为例，名称中的 35B 表示约 350 亿总参数，A3B 表示约 30 亿激活参数。A 是 activated 的提示，不是把 35B 模型直接压缩成 3B 文件。路由节省部分计算，存储仍要考虑完整权重或实际采用的分片、卸载方案。

In the official Qwen3.6-35B-A3B example, 35B denotes about 35 billion total parameters and A3B about 3 billion active parameters. A indicates activation, not a 3B-sized checkpoint. Routing saves some computation while storage still depends on full weights or an actual sharding/offloading scheme.
用统一 16 位做粗算：35×10⁹×2 Byte≈70 GB 原始权重；不能拿 3B×2=6 GB 当作整个模型的显存需求。真实占用还取决于发布精度、额外模块、缓存和引擎实现。这正是“参数活跃得少”与“设备装得下”需要分别判断的原因。

At a uniform 16 bits, raw weights are roughly 35×10⁹×2≈70 GB. Using 3B×2=6 GB as the whole model's requirement is incorrect. Released precision, extra modules, caches and engine implementation also matter.

caption.zh: 因素分离的比较设计，不代表具体软件已支持所有组合。
caption.en: A comparison design, not a claim that real products support every pairing.

zh: 这里把 Codex CLI 当作编程 Agent 软件的例子，GPT 和 Opus 是不同模型家族的名称。前者组织项目、工具和循环，后者生成回答或动作提议。“框架＋模型”表示要比较的一整套组合，不表示任意产品都已经支持直接替换成任意模型。
保持同一个框架换模型，可以观察生成、规划和工具使用有什么变化；保持模型换框架，可以观察上下文整理、执行和反馈组织的变化。模型和框架同时变化时，即使任务更快完成，也不能把全部提升只归给模型。
训练和评测可能让模型习惯某种工具描述、返回格式、工作流程和上下文组织。框架也会根据模型怎样表达思考与调用，设计消息模板、工具适配器和状态处理。双方在接口和行为上配合，可能比单纯把一个模型名称改掉更重要。
例如工具说明要求 read_file(path)，而模型输出的是 open_document(file)。两个名字想做类似的事，程序却不能靠猜测自动认同。工具适配要把参数和结果接好；成功执行后的观察才能回到下一轮。这个例子解释接口匹配，并不要求学生先学习 API 配置。
用“Kimi Code→K2.5”和“DeepSeek harness”这两个例子看系统配合：要把一个模型放回它使用的编程工具链与环境中看。K2.5 是模型版本，Kimi Code 是应用／Agent 产品；同一产品的服务模型可以随版本变化，不能把照片中的配对当成永久规格。当前 Kimi Code 官网已展示其他版本，因此本课把 K2.5 留作具体历史例子。
阅读一个 harness 时，先找输入从哪里来、有哪些工具、执行结果怎样返回、进度存在哪里，以及何时继续。DeepSeek 这个名字既可能指模型，也可能出现在某套应用或实验用框架的配置里；只写品牌名不足以复现系统行为。
en: Here Codex CLI illustrates coding-agent software, while GPT and Opus name different model families. The harness organizes project work, tools and iteration; the model generates responses or action proposals. A harness–model pair is a comparison unit, not a claim that every product accepts every model interchangeably.

Holding the harness fixed while changing the model tests different generation and action behavior. Holding the model fixed while changing the harness tests context and execution organization. If both change, an improvement cannot be attributed solely to the model.

Training and evaluation can familiarize a model with particular tool descriptions, return formats and workflows. A harness also designs templates, adapters and state handling around model behavior. Coordination can matter more than changing a model name alone.

A model may propose open_document(file) while the available tool is read_file(path). Similar intent does not make the calls identical to software. An adapter must connect arguments and results before the observation can feed the next round.

The Kimi Code → K2.5 and DeepSeek harness examples place models back into their working toolchains. K2.5 is a checkpoint; Kimi Code is an agent product. A product's serving model can change. Its current site advertises other versions, so K2.5 remains a concrete historical example rather than a permanent product specification.

To read a harness, locate its inputs, tools, result handling, retained progress and continuation rule. DeepSeek may name a model or appear in an application's configuration. A brand name alone does not specify the complete system behavior.

配合不只是模型名称；再看不同框架究竟承担了哪些文件、工具和状态工作。

Keeping X and replacing A with B studies context, tools and feedback. No invented performance scores are shown.

zh: 薄封装可能只是把文字送到模型并显示回答。更完整的 harness 还会选择相关文件、运行工具、保存任务状态、整理历史、接续较长工作。厚不厚描述承担了多少工作，不是质量评分；有些简单任务只需要一次调用，有些任务则离不开文件与反馈循环。
用整理会议纪要对照：薄封装给一段摘要；完整流程读取录音转录、对照人名表、生成事项、写入任务工具，再呈现新增结果。增加的是可观察的工作步骤，应逐项解释它为任务提供了什么，而不是增加几个装饰性的 Agent 名称。
en: A thin wrapper may send text and display a response. A fuller harness selects files, runs tools, retains state and organizes longer work across contexts. Thickness describes responsibility, not quality: some tasks need one call, while others require files and feedback.

For meeting notes, one wrapper returns a summary; a fuller workflow reads a transcript, checks names, extracts tasks, writes them through a tool and presents the result. Each added step should contribute observable work, rather than merely adding agent labels.

en: Use a specific task, such as fixing a price-sort bug, running tests and explaining the edit. Fix the input and scoring, then compare harness A with models X and Y. Add harness B with X to study the harness. This separates variables rather than predetermining a brand winner.

Retain whether the code is correct, tests pass and actual edits were made, along with time and usage. Returning correct code differs from applying and running it. State repeated-run counts so consistency is visible rather than selecting the prettiest demonstration.

title: Codex 与 GPT／Opus：框架名和模型名分开读
Codex and GPT/Opus: separate the harness name from the model name
paragraphs: 这里把 Codex CLI 当作编程 Agent 软件的例子，GPT 和 Opus 是不同模型家族的名称。前者组织项目、工具和循环，后者生成回答或动作提议。“框架＋模型”表示要比较的一整套组合，不表示任意产品都已经支持直接替换成任意模型。

Here Codex CLI illustrates coding-agent software, while GPT and Opus name different model families. The harness organizes project work, tools and iteration; the model generates responses or action proposals. A harness–model pair is a comparison unit, not a claim that every product accepts every model interchangeably.
保持同一个框架换模型，可以观察生成、规划和工具使用有什么变化；保持模型换框架，可以观察上下文整理、执行和反馈组织的变化。模型和框架同时变化时，即使任务更快完成，也不能把全部提升只归给模型。

Holding the harness fixed while changing the model tests different generation and action behavior. Holding the model fixed while changing the harness tests context and execution organization. If both change, an improvement cannot be attributed solely to the model.

title: 为什么模型与框架会越来越需要配合？
Why does model–harness coordination matter?
points: 模型适应工具与环境，环境组织模型使用
paragraphs: 训练和评测可能让模型习惯某种工具描述、返回格式、工作流程和上下文组织。框架也会根据模型怎样表达思考与调用，设计消息模板、工具适配器和状态处理。双方在接口和行为上配合，可能比单纯把一个模型名称改掉更重要。

Training and evaluation can familiarize a model with particular tool descriptions, return formats and workflows. A harness also designs templates, adapters and state handling around model behavior. Coordination can matter more than changing a model name alone.
例如工具说明要求 read_file(path)，而模型输出的是 open_document(file)。两个名字想做类似的事，程序却不能靠猜测自动认同。工具适配要把参数和结果接好；成功执行后的观察才能回到下一轮。这个例子解释接口匹配，并不要求学生先学习 API 配置。

A model may propose open_document(file) while the available tool is read_file(path). Similar intent does not make the calls identical to software. An adapter must connect arguments and results before the observation can feed the next round.

title: Kimi Code、K2.5 与 DeepSeek harness 的例子
Read the Kimi Code, K2.5 and DeepSeek harness examples
points: 同一品牌应用与模型版本不可混同
paragraphs: 用“Kimi Code→K2.5”和“DeepSeek harness”这两个例子看系统配合：要把一个模型放回它使用的编程工具链与环境中看。K2.5 是模型版本，Kimi Code 是应用／Agent 产品；同一产品的服务模型可以随版本变化，不能把照片中的配对当成永久规格。当前 Kimi Code 官网已展示其他版本，因此本课把 K2.5 留作具体历史例子。

The Kimi Code → K2.5 and DeepSeek harness examples place models back into their working toolchains. K2.5 is a checkpoint; Kimi Code is an agent product. A product's serving model can change. Its current site advertises other versions, so K2.5 remains a concrete historical example rather than a permanent product specification.
阅读一个 harness 时，先找输入从哪里来、有哪些工具、执行结果怎样返回、进度存在哪里，以及何时继续。DeepSeek 这个名字既可能指模型，也可能出现在某套应用或实验用框架的配置里；只写品牌名不足以复现系统行为。

To read a harness, locate its inputs, tools, result handling, retained progress and continuation rule. DeepSeek may name a model or appear in an application's configuration. A brand name alone does not specify the complete system behavior.

lead.en: Request: sort prices [20, 100, 3] from lowest to highest.
